How to Check TNPSC Result 2026

  1. Visit the official TNPSC results page: Click Here.
  2. Look for the result link related to "Automobile Engineer" or the relevant Combined Technical/Engineering Services notification.
  3. Click on the result PDF or link to open it.
  4. Use Ctrl+F (or Command+F on Mac) to search for your registration number within the PDF.
  5. Download and save the result page for future reference.

What Happens Next: Selection Process

TNPSC recruitment for engineering and technical posts typically follows a multi-stage process. The exact stages applicable to this specific result were not confirmed from available sources, but TNPSC selection generally includes:

  • Written Examination
  • Certificate Verification (onscreen and/or physical)
  • Interview or counselling, where applicable to the post
  • Final selection and appointment order

Note: Whether an interview or counselling stage applies to this particular result depends on the specific post and notification. Candidates should check the official result document or notification for the exact next step.

Documents Typically Required for Certificate Verification

The specific document list for this result was not confirmed from available sources. In general, TNPSC certificate verification for technical/engineering posts commonly requires candidates to carry:

  • Original and photocopies of educational certificates (degree/diploma mark sheets)
  • Date of birth proof (10th or 12th mark sheet)
  • Community certificate, if applicable
  • Valid photo ID proof
  • Recent passport-size photographs
  • TNPSC registration/application printout

Confirm the exact document checklist from the official certificate verification notice once released, as requirements can vary by post and category.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Keep your TNPSC registration number and login credentials handy while checking the result.
  • Cross-check your name, registration number, and marks (if shown) carefully against your admit card.
  • Save a copy of the result page or PDF for future reference.
  • Regularly monitor tnpsc.gov.in for updates on certificate verification, interview, or counselling schedules.
  • Do not rely on unofficial sources for confirmation always cross-verify with the official TNPSC website.

Selection Process

Based on the official notice, the selection process for this recruitment involves the following stages:

  1. Stenography Proficiency Test - conducted from 04.07.2026 to 07.07.2026 (completed).
  2. Written Examination - part of the Combined Graduate Level Examination 2026, scheduled for 30.08.2026.

  • Candidates must possess all requisite documents as per Advt. No. 03/26, dated 09.03.2026; failure to do so may lead to summary rejection at any stage.
  • Venue and timing details for the Written Examination will be communicated separately through the e-Admit Card.

How to Check RRB Group D Result 2026

This section walks candidates through the exact steps to access and download their individual result and scorecard from the official RRB portal.

Candidates can follow these steps to check their RRB Group D Result 2026:

  1. Visit the official website of the RRB region under which you applied.
  2. Locate the result link for "RRB Group D CEN 08/2024 Level 1 Result" on the homepage.
  3. Click on the relevant result link for your zone.
  4. Download the result PDF that appears on screen.
  5. Use Ctrl+F to search for your registration number within the PDF.
  6. Log in with your registration number and date of birth to view your detailed scorecard.
  7. Download and save the result for future reference.

RRB Group D Zone-Wise Result: What It Contains

Since RRB Group D results are declared separately by each regional board, this section explains how the zone-wise system works and what candidates will find in their result PDF.

The RRB Group D Result 2026 is published individually by each of the 21 RRB zones on their respective regional websites, rather than through a single centralized portal. Each zone-wise result PDF contains the registration numbers of candidates who have qualified the CBT and been shortlisted for the next stage. Candidates should check the result specifically on the website of the region under which they applied.

RRB Group D Scorecard 2026

This section explains what information is available in the individual scorecard and how to access it.

Along with the result, RRB has released the scorecard for candidates who appeared in the CBT. The scorecard includes the candidate's name, registration number, category, section-wise and overall marks, and the normalized score. Candidates need to log in with their user ID and password to download it; RRB does not send a physical copy by post.

RRB Group D Selection Process After Result

Qualifying in the CBT is only the first step. This section outlines what happens next for shortlisted candidates.

Candidates who qualify in the CBT will proceed through the following stages:

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): A qualifying-only round involving physical tasks; separate standards apply for male and female candidates.
  • Document Verification (DV): Verification of original certificates and eligibility documents.
  • Medical Examination: A medical fitness test as per Railway standards for the applied post.

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the First Round of Tentative Allocation list for the Junior Engineer (Civil, Mechanical & Electrical) Examination, 2025. This list carries the names and roll numbers of candidates who have been provisionally shortlisted for the post of Junior Engineer (Civil/Electrical/Mechanical) after completion of the selection process. Candidates who appeared for the SSC JE 2025 exam can now check their roll number in this roll-number-wise list to know their provisional post and category allocation.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

This article explains what the SSC JE First Round Tentative Allocation list contains, how to read the category codes used in it, how to check your roll number, and what steps to take after finding your name in the list.

Direct to Check SSC JE 2025 First Round Tentative Allocation List

SSC JE 2025 First Round Tentative Allocation: Key Details

Particulars Details
Conducting Body Staff Selection Commission (SSC)
Name of Exam Junior Engineer (Civil, Mechanical & Electrical) Examination, 2025
Name of Post Junior Engineer (Civil / Electrical / Mechanical)
Document Released First Round of Tentative Allocation List
List Arrangement Roll Number Order
Status Provisional / Tentative
Details Shown Roll No., Name, Father's Name, Mother's Name, Category, Post Selected, Category Selected, Rank/Serial No.
Official Website ssc.gov.in

What Is the SSC JE First Round Tentative Allocation List?

Once the SSC JE selection process (Paper I, Paper II and Document Verification) is completed, the Commission prepares a final result of candidates who qualify for the post of Junior Engineer. Based on the choices filled by candidates and the number of vacancies notified by different user departments (such as CPWD, BRO, MES, and other central government organisations), SSC then carries out a post-preference-based allocation exercise. The First Round of Tentative Allocation is the first output of this exercise. It shows, against each roll number, the category under which the candidate has been considered (CAT1, CAT2, CAT3), the post finally selected for the candidate (POSTSEL), the category under which the selection has been made (CATSEL), and the candidate's rank or serial number in that category and post combination.

SSC JE 2025 Category Codes Explained

The allocation list uses numeric codes instead of full category names. These codes are explained at the bottom of every page of the official document. Here is what each code stands for:

Code Category
0 EWS (Economically Weaker Section)
1 SC (Scheduled Caste)
2 ST (Scheduled Tribe)
3 ESM (Ex-Servicemen)
4 OH (Orthopaedically Handicapped)
5 HH (Hearing Handicapped)
6 OBC (Other Backward Classes)
8 PWD-Other (Persons with Disability - Other)
9 UR (Unreserved)

Understanding CAT1, CAT2, CAT3, CATSEL and POSTSEL

  • CAT1: The primary category under which the candidate applied or was considered.
  • CAT2: A letter code representing the specific user department or organisation being considered for allocation.
  • CAT3: A secondary category number relevant to the allocation round.
  • CATSEL: The final category under which the candidate has been tentatively selected in this round.
  • POSTSEL: The department/organisation code under which the candidate has been tentatively allocated a post.
  • RANK: The candidate's serial number, shown as "SL\" followed by a number, indicating merit position within the relevant category/post combination.

Details Mentioned Against Each Candidate in the List

Every entry in the SSC JE First Round Tentative Allocation list is arranged roll-number wise and includes the following information:

  1. Record/Serial number in the PDF
  2. Roll Number
  3. Candidate's Name
  4. Father's Name
  5. Mother's Name
  6. Category codes (CAT1, CAT2, CAT3)
  7. Post Selected (POSTSEL)
  8. Category Selected (CATSEL)
  9. Rank (shown as an SL number)

How to Check Your Roll Number in the SSC JE Allocation List

  1. Visit the official SSC website, ssc.gov.in.
  2. Go to the "Results" or "Notice Board" section on the homepage.
  3. Look for the link related to "Junior Engineer (Civil, Mech & Elect), 2025 - First Round of Tentative Allocation."
  4. Open the PDF and use the search/find function (Ctrl+F) to locate your roll number quickly.
  5. Note down your CAT1, CAT2, CAT3, POSTSEL, CATSEL and RANK details against your roll number.
  6. Download and save the PDF, or take a screenshot of your entry for future reference.

What Does "Tentative" Allocation Mean?

The word "tentative" is important. This allocation is provisional and can change in subsequent rounds based on factors such as vacancy revisions, withdrawal of candidature by some candidates, changes in reservation rosters, or corrections after representations from candidates. Candidates should treat this list as an indicative status of where they currently stand, and should keep checking the official website for further rounds of allocation or any final confirmation before it is treated as conclusive.

What to Do After Finding Your Name in the List

  • Verify that your name, roll number, father's name and mother's name are correctly printed.
  • Cross-check the category (CATSEL) and post (POSTSEL) shown against your entry.
  • If you notice any discrepancy, watch for an official window to raise objections or corrections, as intimated by SSC.
  • Keep checking the official website regularly for subsequent allocation rounds, joining instructions, or further communication from the allocated department.
  • Do not rely on unofficial sources for confirmation c always cross-verify with the PDF published on the official SSC website.

About SSC JE (Civil, Mechanical & Electrical) Examination 2025

The SSC JE Examination is conducted every year by the Staff Selection Commission to recruit Junior Engineers for various central government departments and organisations, including CPWD, BRO, MES and others, across Civil, Mechanical and Electrical disciplines. The selection process typically consists of a Computer Based Examination (Paper I and Paper II) followed by document verification, after which a final result and subsequent allocation lists such as this one are released.

What Is the RRB NTPC CBTST Result 2025-26?

The CBTST (Computer Based Typing Skill Test) is a qualifying stage specifically for Category 4 and Category 5 NTPC Graduate posts, which require typing skills. RRB Jammu-Srinagar has now shortlisted additional candidates for all posts, including Category 4 and 5, based on their CBT-2 marks and their qualifying status in CBTST  not on CBTST marks or merit ranking. Roll numbers in the official list are arranged in ascending order, not by merit.

Is this the same as the RRB NTPC Category 1, 2, 3 Final Result?

No. This CBTST-based shortlisting for Category 4 & 5 is a separate exercise from the Category 1, 2, and 3 result (based on CBT-2 and CBAT) that RRB zones released earlier, around May 2026. Candidates should not confuse the two results, as they cover different post categories and different qualifying stages.

How to Check RRB NTPC CBTST Result 2025-26?

  1. Visit the official result/scorecard login link: rrbapply.gov.in/.
  2. Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit to view your CBTST qualifying status and score card.
  4. Download and save the score card, as it will remain live for only 15 days from activation.

What After RRB NTPC CBTST Result 2025-26?

Candidates shortlisted in this list will now go through Document Verification (DV) followed by Medical Examination.

What happens during RRB NTPC Document Verification?

  • Candidates will be scheduled for DV and notified via email/SMS/website with an e-call letter containing date, time, and reporting venue.
  • Original documents plus two self-attested photocopy sets (A4 size) must be carried, as detailed in the CEN and e-call letter.
  • Scanned true-colour copies of all required documents, photo, and signature must be uploaded through the DV portal: oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv. This link becomes active as per a separately issued DV notice.
  • All certificates must be in the prescribed format, in English or Hindi only.
  • No extra time will be given for candidates who fail to bring original certificates on the DV date.
  • Candidates absent during DV or Medical Examination will forfeit their candidature.

What happens during the Medical Examination?

  • Candidates are sent to a nominated Railway Hospital, generally on the day after DV, within the RRB's jurisdiction.
  • Candidates must pay a prescribed medical fee of Rs. 24 only; no other charges apply to the hospital/health unit.
  • For rare additional investigations (CT scan, ultrasound, refractive eye surgery tests) not available at the Railway Hospital, candidates may need to pay the concerned laboratory/hospital directly.
  • Candidates should prepare to be available for 3 to 4 days, covering both DV and medical examination, including travel to the hospital city.

Important Instructions for RRB NTPC CBTST Shortlisted Candidates

  • Shortlisting for DV is purely provisional and can be cancelled at any stage if any inconsistency is found in the candidate's online application data, or if any irregularity comes to RRB's notice.
  • Being called for DV does not guarantee appointment in the Railways.
  • The final select list depends on merit, post preference, medical fitness, and vacancy availability at the time of panel preparation. The final cut-off may go up or down after DV and medical examination.
  • RRB reserves the right to correct any inadvertent error or printing mistake in the shortlisted candidates' list.
  • RRB will not entertain correspondence from unsuccessful candidates.
  • Candidates are advised to be cautious of touts making false promises of selection through illegal means. The RRB selection process is fully computerised and merit-based.

A reserve list is a backup panel that IBPS prepares after declaring the final result of the CRP RRBs-XIV exam. Once the primary list of selected candidates is allotted to participating banks, some vacancies remain unfilled because certain selected candidates do not join within the deadline, resign shortly after joining, or get rejected at the document verification stage. To ensure every sanctioned post is filled, IBPS draws candidates from the reserve panel, based on merit, category, and the number of vacancies still open, and provisionally allots them to a Regional Rural Bank for the Office Assistant/Customer Service Associate (Clerk) post.

This section gives you the official login link to view your provisional allotment status under the reserve list.

Candidates who appeared in the IBPS RRB Clerk Mains exam but did not feature in the original selection list can check their status through the official IBPS portal. Login requires your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth.

IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 Login Link (Active)

This section outlines the step-by-step process to view and download your reserve list allotment status.

  1. Visit the official IBPS website at ibps.in.
  2. Click on the "CRP-CSA (Customer Service Associate)" tab on the homepage.
  3. Select "CRP-CRP XIV – Provisional Allotment under Reserve List."
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth.
  5. Fill in the captcha code and click on the Login button.
  6. View your allotment status and download the result for future reference.

How Will You Know If You're Selected?

This section explains how IBPS notifies candidates who get provisional allotment through the reserve list.

Candidates who are provisionally allotted a bank through the reserve list will receive an official communication via email and SMS on their registered email ID and mobile number. It is advisable to regularly check your registered contact details and the official IBPS portal so you don't miss any update.

What Happens After the Reserve List Allotment?

This section explains the next stages candidates must complete after receiving a provisional allotment.

Getting your name on the reserve list does not mean final selection it is a provisional allotment that becomes confirmed only after the bank completes verification. The typical process that follows includes:

  • Document Verification: Submission of original certificates and identity proofs for cross-checking.
  • Submission of Required Certificates: Educational, category, and other eligibility-related documents as specified by the allotted bank.
  • Medical Examination: Some banks may require a fitness check before final confirmation.
  • Joining Formalities: Completion of paperwork and reporting to the allotted branch.
  • Induction/Training Process: Orientation and training conducted by the bank before you begin regular duties.

Candidates should keep all original and photocopied documents ready in advance to avoid last-minute issues during verification.

Why Does IBPS Release a Reserve List?

This section explains the broader purpose behind the reserve list mechanism in IBPS recruitment.

A reserve list helps maintain smooth recruitment by ensuring sanctioned vacancies don't remain vacant. It benefits candidates who narrowly missed the initial cut-off by giving them another opportunity, while also helping banks manage manpower requirements efficiently across states and categories.

Why Did SBI Release a Waiting List?

This section explains the reason behind the waiting list, addressing why some candidates are getting a second chance even after the final result was declared.

A waiting list is generated to fill vacancies left vacant due to two main reasons:

  • Non-joining: Some originally selected candidates choose not to join SBI after final selection.
  • Resignation: Some candidates join but resign shortly afterward, freeing up their position.

Rather than running an entirely new selection process, SBI fills these vacancies from the existing pool of candidates who appeared in the merit list but missed selection by a narrow margin.

This section explains the next procedural steps for candidates who find their roll number in the list, so they know exactly what to expect.

Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the 1st Waiting List are only provisionally selected. If a candidate fails to produce the required documents or does not meet the eligibility criteria, the bank can cancel their provisional selection.

Exam Pattern and Marking Scheme

The examination for all the above posts will be conducted in MCQ-CBRT format (Multiple Choice Question, Computer Based Recruitment Test). Key points about the exam pattern as mentioned in the notice:

  • Each question will have four options, out of which candidates must select the correct answer.

  • Biometric verification of candidates will be conducted at the exam center.

How to Download GSSSB Call Letter 2026: Step-by-Step Guide

All candidates belonging to the above cadres can download their online call letter (admit card) from 5:00 PM on 10 July 2026 until 15 minutes before the exam starts, by following these steps:

  1. Step 1: Click on the official call letter link: Click Here
  2. Step 2: On the login page, enter your Advertisement Number, Confirmation Number, Date of Birth (DDMMYYYY), and the captcha/image text shown, then click the Login button.

  4. Step 4: Click on the Admit Card option to download your online call letter. Take a physical printout of it.

Candidates must carry the printed call letter to the exam center on the exam day and carefully read and follow all instructions mentioned on it.

Also Read: RRB NTPC CBTST Result 2025-26

Important Exam Day Instructions

  • Candidates must reach the exam center by the reporting time (7:30 AM) shown in the call letter. Entry will not be given under any circumstances to candidates arriving after the reporting time.
  • Biometric verification will be carried out for all candidates at the exam center.
  • Candidates must bring a physical printout of the online call letter to the exam center; it is compulsory.
  • Candidates should carefully read all instructions printed on the call letter, since they are also needed for filling attendance sheet details and for the exam process.

Documents Required for Scribe/Compensatory Time Application

Sr. No. Document
1 Copy of the online application form filled by the candidate
2 Photocopy of the candidate's identity proof
3 Proof of disability / temporary disability certificate (APPENDIX-I, issued by a competent authority i.e. Civil Surgeon)
4 Identity proof of the scribe (lahiya)
5 Proof that the scribe's educational qualification is not more than one level below the minimum qualification required for the post
6 Age proof of the scribe (Aadhaar Card / Birth Certificate / SSC mark sheet showing date of birth / School bonafide certificate / School leaving certificate)

Special Category Rule (Blindness, Both-Hand Disability, Cerebral Palsy)

According to the notice, candidates with blindness, disability in both hands, or cerebral palsy are treated differently from other categories. All other disabled candidates, along with candidates with temporary disability due to accidental circumstances who are unable to write or face difficulty writing, must additionally submit a medical certificate as per APPENDIX-I (Certificate regarding physical limitation in an examinee to write) along with supporting evidence, in person or via email, to the Mandal. The Mandal's decision on eligibility for this facility, based on the submitted evidence, is stated to be final.

Duties of the Scribe (Lahiya)

  • The scribe must sit at a distance from the candidate such that the candidate cannot easily touch him/her.
  • During the exam, the scribe must carefully read out the instructions given on the question booklet, OMR answer sheet, or on the computer screen (in case of CBRT), to the candidate.
  • The scribe must read out questions as instructed by the candidate and carefully mark (encode) the answers exactly as the candidate directs.
  • The scribe must inform the candidate about time remaining, as instructed by the candidate.
  • The scribe must not mark any answer on his/her own judgment, must not lead or hint the candidate towards any answer, and must not discuss exam matters with the invigilator or others in the exam hall.
  • If the scribe engages in indiscipline or misconduct in the exam hall, the candidate who availed the scribe's help will be held responsible, and disciplinary action may be taken. The candidate's candidature is liable to be cancelled in such cases.

For all future competitive exams conducted by the Mandal, candidates seeking scribe/compensatory time facility must submit the prescribed form along with self-attested copies of required documents for prior approval, generally at least 5 days before the exam date, or as per the instructions in the relevant advertisement.

A Provisionally Accepted status means the candidate's application meets the eligibility criteria based on the details submitted. What does Conditionally Accepted mean?

A Conditionally Accepted status means the application has been accepted subject to certain conditions specified by the RRB. Candidates should read the conditions carefully and take necessary action if required.

A Rejected status is shown along with the specific reason for rejection, such as incomplete details, document mismatch, or non-fulfilment of eligibility conditions. Candidates are advised to review the reason mentioned on their status page.

CBI Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026

The Central Bank of India has announced a total of 4,500 Apprentice vacancies for the financial year 2026-27, distributed across various states and union territories. Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh reportedly have the largest state-wise allocations. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification PDF on the bank's recruitment page for the exact state-wise and category-wise vacancy breakup, since detailed figures for every state were not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit, and nationality conditions set by the Central Bank of India to be eligible for the Apprentice post.

Educational Qualification

  • A graduation degree (bachelor's degree) in any discipline from a recognised university or institute.
  • Candidates should have completed graduation on or after 1 January 2022 (some sources indicate the cut-off as 1 January 2021; candidates should verify the exact date on the official notification).
  • Candidates with one year or more of work or training experience after graduation are not eligible, since this scheme is meant for fresh graduates.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training elsewhere, are not eligible.
  • Basic computer knowledge is required.
  • Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the state they are applying for.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 31 May 2026, meaning they should be born between 31 May 1998 and 31 May 2006 (both dates inclusive).

Category Age Relaxation

SC / ST 5 years

Candidates should check the official notification for the exact category-wise age relaxation applicable to them.

Salary / Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹15,000 during the 12-month training period. This is a training stipend rather than a regular salary, and no other allowances or benefits are provided. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment with the bank.

Application Fee

The exact application fee amount for the CBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 was not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article. Candidates should refer to the official Central Bank of India Apprentice notification PDF on centralbank.bank.in for accurate, category-wise fee details, since this cannot be reliably stated here.

Selection Process

The Central Bank of India Apprentice selection process involves two stages:

  1. Online Written Examination: An objective-type computer-based test with no negative marking for wrong answers.
  2. Local Language Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify the online exam may need to appear for a test assessing reading, writing, and speaking skills in the local language of the applied state. Candidates who studied the local language at Class 10 or Class 12 level may be exempted from this test, subject to document verification.

Final selection also depends on document verification and meeting the required medical fitness standards set by the bank.

Documents Required at the Exam Centre

  • Printed copy of the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026
  • A valid original government-issued photo ID proof, such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence
  • A photocopy of the photo ID for verification
  • Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions

Candidates should ensure the name on their ID proof matches the name printed on the admit card to avoid denial of entry.

How to Download the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026

Follow these steps to download your Central Bank of India Apprentice hall ticket:

  1. Visit the official website of the Central Bank of India at centralbankofindia.co.in or centralbank.bank.in.
  2. Go to the "Recruitment" or "Careers" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the "CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026" or "Download Call Letter" link.

  6. Click the Login or Submit button.

  8. Carefully verify all details, including your name, photograph, signature, exam date, and exam centre.
  9. Download the admit card and take a clear printout on an A4 sheet for the examination.

The Cotton Corporation of India Ltd (CCI) has released a recruitment notification (Advt No. DR/CCI/2026 dated 09/07/2026) inviting online applications for 148 vacancies across the posts of Assistant Manager, Management Trainee, Junior Commercial Executive, and Junior Assistant. CCI is a Government of India Undertaking under the Ministry of Textiles. Eligible and interested candidates can apply online through the official website www.cotcorp.org.in from 09/07/2026 to 24/07/2026. This article provides complete details on vacancies, eligibility, age limit, salary, application fee, selection process, and how to apply.

CCI Recruitment 2026 - Overview

The Cotton Corporation of India Ltd (CCI) provides marketing support to cotton growers across the country through more than 590 market yards and 19 branches. CCI has invited applications for direct recruitment against various posts. Below is a quick overview of the notification.

Organization The Cotton Corporation of India Ltd (CCI)

Vacancy Details

CCI has announced a total of 148 vacancies across seven posts. The post-wise vacancy breakup, including regular and backlog posts, is given below.

Eligibility Criteria

Nationality

A candidate must be a citizen of India.

Educational Qualification

The educational qualification varies by post. Candidates must check the specific requirement for the post they intend to apply for before submitting their application.

Post Code Post Name Qualification
101 Assistant Manager (Official Language) Post graduate degree in Hindi with minimum 50% marks in aggregate; should have studied English as one subject up to graduation and be well conversant in Hindi. Qualification in Hindi translation and MBA are added advantages. Minimum 1 year experience in an organization of repute.
102 Assistant Manager (Information Technology) BE (IT/CS), MCA, or MBA/PGDM with specialization in IT/System with minimum 50% marks in aggregate; minimum 1 year experience in a reputed public/private sector organization holding a responsible position.
103 Management Trainee (Marketing) MBA in Agri Business Management/Agriculture related Management equivalent to MBA.
104 Management Trainee (Accounts) CA/CMA
105 Junior Commercial Executive B.Sc Agriculture from a recognized University with 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates).

107 Junior Assistant (General) Any Graduate from a recognized University with 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates).

For post codes 105, 106 and 107, employees currently working in CCI (regular/temporary) require Any Graduate (10+2+3) qualification, with age relaxation limited to their years of service in CCI.

Selection Process

Selection for CCI Recruitment 2026 will be made through a Computer Based Test followed by Document Verification.

  • The written test will consist of 120 objective-type MCQs to be completed in 120 minutes.
  • 1 mark will be awarded for each correct answer, with 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer.
  • The test covers General English, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, General Knowledge, Computer Proficiency (post-wise), and Subject Knowledge specific to the post.

Minimum qualifying percentage for the Computer Based Test is as follows:

Category Minimum Qualifying Percentage
UR/EWS/OBC 40%
SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen 35%

Examinations will be conducted in Mumbai/Navi Mumbai, Hyderabad, New Delhi, Chennai, Lucknow, Chandigarh, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, Patna, and Jaipur.

Documents Required

Candidates must upload scanned copies of the following documents at the time of online application:

  • Recent passport size color photograph
  • Recent scanned signature
  • 10th class certificate/mark sheet
  • 12th class certificate/mark sheet
  • Essential qualification degree certificate
  • Additional qualification degree certificate (if any)
  • Experience certificate (if applicable)

Original documents along with photocopies will be required at the time of document verification.

How to Apply

Eligible candidates can apply for CCI Recruitment 2026 by following the steps below:

  1. Visit the official website www.cotcorp.org.in and click on the "Recruitment" link.
  2. Read the advertisement carefully and verify eligibility for the post.
  3. Click "Enter" and fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and other required details.
  4. Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Preview the application form and read the declaration before submission.
  6. Pay the applicable application fee/intimation charges through the online payment gateway.
  7. Take a printout of the application form and the fee payment receipt for future reference.

Note: The online application, once submitted, cannot be altered or withdrawn under any circumstances. Candidates can apply for only one post; multiple applications will be summarily rejected.

Important Instructions

  • Candidates are advised not to bring mobile phones or any electronic/communication devices to the examination venue.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to fill or not fill any of the advertised posts without assigning any reason.
  • Candidates already employed with Government/Semi-Government/PSU organizations must submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of document verification.
  • Category, once selected in the application form, cannot be changed at any later stage.
  • No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the written test or document verification.

Salary / Remuneration – CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator 2026

Selected candidates under the CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026 will be paid as per the state government's prescribed wage structure. The remuneration for all selected Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator candidates will be the minimum wages of the respective state set for semi-skilled manpower. The exact figure will vary from state to state based on the applicable minimum wage notification of Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, or Maharashtra.

How to Obtain the Aadhaar Supervisor Certificate Before Applying

Candidates who do not yet hold the mandatory Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate need to complete two steps before they are eligible to apply for CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra jobs. First, they must apply for and pass the Aadhaar Supervisor exam; second, they must complete the LMS certification. Both processes are managed through official UIDAI platforms.

  1. Visit the Aadhaar Supervisor exam portal at https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action and submit your exam application.
  2. An authorization request will be sent to the State Team. Once approved, you will be permitted to appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam.
  3. After your LMS ID and Password are created and approved, appear for the Aadhaar LMS Certification through the portal at https://e-learning.uidai.gov.in
  4. Once certified, proceed to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor district post on the CSC Job Portal.

How to Apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026

The CSC Aadhaar Operator Apply Online 2026 process is conducted entirely through the official CSC Job Portal at career.csccloud.in. Candidates must ensure they have their Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate ready before beginning the application. The last date to apply is 20 August 2026, and no offline applications are accepted under this recruitment.

  1. Visit the official CSC Job Portal at career.csccloud.in.
  2. Navigate to the relevant job post for your state – Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, or Maharashtra.
  3. Click on the "Apply Now" button on the job post page.
  4. Fill in the online application form with your personal, educational, and certification details.
  5. Upload the required documents including your Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate.
  6. Submit the application form before 20 August 2026.

CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Apply Online 2026

Eligible candidates can submit their online applications for the CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026 through the official CSC Job Portal. The apply online facility is available for all four states – Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra. Ensure your Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate is valid and issued by a UIDAI-authorized agency before clicking Apply Now. The online application window closes on 20 August 2026.

State Apply Online Link
Bihar Apply Now – Bihar
Chhattisgarh Apply Now – Chhattisgarh
Madhya Pradesh Apply Now – Madhya Pradesh
Maharashtra Apply Now – Maharashtra

Common Mistakes to Avoid in CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026

Many candidates make avoidable errors while applying for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Vacancy 2026 that can lead to rejection of their application. The points below are based on common patterns seen in similar contractual government recruitment drives and are not derived from the official notification.

  1. Applying without a valid UIDAI certificate: The Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate from a UIDAI-authorized agency is a mandatory requirement. Applying without it will result in disqualification.
  2. VLEs applying despite ineligibility: VLEs are explicitly barred from applying. Submitting an application as a VLE wastes your time and will be rejected at the verification stage.
  3. Applying for the wrong district: Each vacancy is district-specific. Ensure you apply for the correct district as per your location and preference.
  4. Incomplete LMS Certification: Candidates sometimes have the Supervisor exam cleared but not the LMS Certification. Both are required before applying.
  5. Submitting incorrect documents: Upload clear, legible scans of your educational certificates and Aadhaar Operator certificate. Blurry or mismatched documents can cause rejection.
  6. Missing the last date: The portal closes applications on 20 August 2026. Do not wait until the last day — technical issues near the deadline are common.
  7. Confusing CSC e-Governance with state government jobs: This is a contractual, not permanent government post. Ensure you understand the terms of engagement before applying.

Eligibility Criteria

Nationality

  • A citizen of India, or
  • A subject of Nepal, or
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, or East African countries (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia) and Vietnam, with the intention of permanently settling in India, provided a certificate of eligibility has been issued by the Government of India (not required for Gorkha subjects of Nepal).

Marital Status

Open only to unmarried male candidates. Candidates must not marry until they complete the full training at the Officers Training Academy. Marrying during training or after applying (before joining) leads to cancellation/discharge.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 27 years as on 01 Apr 2027, i.e., born between 01 Apr 2000 and 31 Mar 2007 (both dates inclusive).

Only the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate (or equivalent) is accepted. No other document for age proof is accepted, and no request for change of recorded date of birth is considered later.

Minimum Physical Standards (Before Joining Training Academy)

Activity Minimum Standard (Officer Cadets – Men)
2.4 Km Run 10 minutes 30 seconds
Push-Up 40
Pull-Up 06
Sit-Up 30
Squats Two sets of 30 repetitions
Lunges Two sets of 10 repetitions
Swimming Basic knowledge of swimming required

Educational Qualification

  • Candidates who have passed the required engineering degree, or are in the final year of an engineering degree course in a notified stream, are eligible to apply.
  • Final-year candidates must be able to submit proof of passing the engineering degree examination, along with marksheets of all semesters/years, by 01 April 2027, and produce the degree certificate within 12 weeks from the start of PCTA training.
  • Candidates whose final year/final semester result is declared after 29 March 2027 are not eligible to apply for this course.
  • Final-year candidates are provisionally allowed to appear for the SSB if their cumulative percentage of marks up to the 6th semester/3rd year (Engineering), 8th semester/4th year (B.Arch), or 2nd semester/1st year (M.Sc in a notified equivalent stream) is not below the approved cut-off percentage for their stream.
  • After final results are declared, the cumulative percentage up to the final semester/year must also not fall below the approved cut-off, or the candidature will be cancelled.
  • The degree must be from a university/institution recognized by an Act of Parliament/State Legislature or deemed university under UGC Act 1956, IIT Act 1961, AICTE Act 1987, NITSER Act 2007, or IIIT Act 2024. Degrees from foreign universities are not accepted.

Selection Process

The Indian Army SSC (Tech)-68 Men selection follows this sequence:

Application > Shortlisting > SSB > Medical Examination > Merit List > Joining Letter

1. Shortlisting of Applications

Applications are shortlisted stream-wise based on the vacancy-to-call-up ratio and the cumulative percentage of marks obtained up to the final semester/year, without the Army being required to state a reason. The shortlisting cut-off percentage is expected to be published in the first week of September 2026.

2. Selection of SSB Centre and Dates

After shortlisting, candidates log in to the website to select their SSB dates and centre on a first-come, first-served basis. Once selected, the centre and date generally cannot be changed. This window is expected to open for two weeks in September 2026.

3. SSB Interview

  • Shortlisted candidates are called to one of four Selection Centres: Prayagraj (UP), Bhopal (MP), Bengaluru (Karnataka), and Jalandhar (Punjab).
  • The SSB is a two-stage process. Candidates who clear Stage-1 proceed to Stage-2; those who do not clear Stage-1 are sent back the same day.
  • The SSB interview lasts up to five days, likely held between October and December 2026.
  • Candidates recommended after Stage-2 undergo a medical examination.

4. Medical Examination

Medical standards and examination procedures are detailed on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in. The SSB medical examination is valid for 270 days from the Special Medical Board (SMB) date to the PCTA joining date. Candidates already declared "Medically Fit" in a prior SSB medical (within the 270-day validity relative to 01 Apr 2027) need not undergo the medical again.

5. Merit List

Qualifying the SSB interview alone does not confirm final selection. A stream-wise merit list is prepared based on SSB interview marks. In case of a tie in SSB marks, the older candidate is ranked higher; if age is also equal, the candidate with a higher percentage in the qualifying degree is ranked higher. Higher educational qualifications or past performance play no role in merit ranking.

Training Details

  • Training Academy: Officers Training Academy (OTA), Gaya, Bihar
  • Duration: 49 weeks, from April 2027 to March 2028
  • Stipend during training: ₹56,100 per month (equal to the starting pay in Level-10 of the pay matrix)
  • Rank on commissioning: Lieutenant, granted Short Service Commission on probation from the course start date or PCTA reporting date, whichever is later
  • Ante-date seniority: One year ante-date seniority is granted from the date of commission
  • Academic award: On successful completion of training, candidates are awarded a "Post Graduate Diploma in Military Studies & Defence Management" by Magadh University, Bodh Gaya
  • Marriage restriction: Not permitted to marry during training; violation leads to discharge and recovery of expenses
  • Cost of training recovery: If an Officer Cadet resigns/withdraws from training for reasons other than medical grounds, the cost of training (₹20,482.40 per week for the 01 Jul 2026–30 Jun 2027 period, as revised from time to time) must be refunded

Documents Required for SSB Interview

Candidates must carry self-attested copies along with original documents to the Selection Centre. DigiLocker certificates are not accepted in place of originals unless accompanied by an authentication letter from the institution confirming only e-certificates were issued.

  • Marksheets of all semesters/years
  • Certificate from the university's Controller of Examination/Registrar regarding the CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula
  • Certificate confirming cumulative percentage up to the relevant semester/year (for final-year appearing candidates)

  • Declaration by final-year candidates that they will submit proof of passing along with all marksheets by 01 April 2027
  • Documents related to civil/character verification
  • An affidavit is required if there is any variation between the candidate's name/parents' names on educational documents and the online application

How to Apply for Indian Army SSC Tech 68 Men Online

  1. Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  2. Click on "Officer Entry Application/Login," then click "Registration" (skip this step if already registered on the portal).
  3. Fill the online registration form after carefully reading the instructions. Aadhaar number and matriculation certificate details are mandatory for registration.
  4. After registering, click "Apply Online" under the Dashboard.
  5. On the "Officers Selection – Eligibility" page, click "Apply" against the Short Service Commission Technical Course.
  6. Fill in the Application Form across all sections: personal information, communication details, education details, and previous SSB details (if any). Click "Save & Continue" after each section.
  7. Review all entries on the "Summary of your information" page.
  8. Click "Submit" only after confirming all details are correct.
  9. Take two printouts of the application (with roll number) 30 minutes after the final closure of the online application on the last day.

Important: No changes can be made to the submitted application after the closing date, and no representation on this will be entertained.

Important Instructions to Note

  • Any mismatch between the engineering stream on the degree certificate/marksheet and the stream selected in the online application will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Any variation in the candidate's name or parents' names between educational documents and the application requires an affidavit explaining the variation.
  • CGPA/Grades must be converted to marks using the formula adopted by the candidate's own university before filling in "Marks obtained in Graduation."
  • Only one online application is allowed per candidate; multiple applications result in cancellation.
  • Candidates already serving in the Armed Forces must inform their Commanding Officer in writing about applying, and their application must be countersigned by the Commanding Officer.
  • Candidates who have ever been debarred by UPSC from any examination are not eligible.
  • Candidates arrested, convicted by a criminal court, or involved in a criminal case are not eligible; discovery of such facts at any stage leads to cancellation/withdrawal.
  • Candidates withdrawn from NDA, IMA, OTA, Naval Academy, Air Force Academy, or any service training academy on disciplinary grounds are not eligible to apply.
  • Requests for change of SSB interview date or centre will not be entertained or replied to.
  • The notification is published in Hindi and English; in case of any discrepancy, the English version prevails.

Travelling Allowance for SSB Interview

Candidates appearing for the SSB interview for the first time for this type of commission are entitled to AC-3 Tier railway fare (or equivalent bus fare, including reservation/sleeper charges) within Indian limits, for to-and-fro travel. Candidates reappearing for the same type of commission are not entitled to travelling allowance on subsequent occasions.

CWC Young Professional Roles and Responsibilities

Post Code 01: Young Professional (Learning & Development)

  • Supporting the formulation and execution of the Annual Training and Capacity Building Plan and conducting Training Needs Analysis (TNA).
  • Assisting in designing functional, behavioral, and leadership development programs, and coordinating with external training institutes and consultants.
  • Managing end-to-end training logistics, maintaining the Training Calendar, and preparing training reports and dashboards.
  • Supporting implementation of Learning Management Systems/e-learning platforms, including the iGOT Karmayogi Portal.
  • Analyzing training feedback and effectiveness, and preparing periodic reports on Learning & Development outcomes and ROI.

Post Code 02: Young Professional (PCS Marketing)

  • Identifying new business opportunities and clients for pest control services, and supporting preparation of proposals, tenders, and quotations.
  • Conducting market surveys and competitor analysis, and maintaining liaison with existing clients.
  • Coordinating with Field units/Technical Teams to achieve marketing targets and revenue goals.
  • Maintaining records of tenders participated in, awarded, and pending, and supporting timely billing and documentation.
  • Supporting digital and offline marketing initiatives for PCS (Pest Control Services).

Post Code 03: Young Professional (Marketing & Business Development) - Hyderabad

  • Conducting market research to identify stakeholders, trends, and competitors relevant to CWC's warehousing and logistics services.
  • Engaging with farmers, FPOs, FPCs, banks, and trading platforms for post-harvest warehousing, as well as bulk procurers, e-commerce operators, and 3PL/4PL/5PL operators.
  • Engaging with EXIM and Private Container Train Operator (PCTO) stakeholders including shipping lines, freight forwarders, Customs, and Indian Railways.
  • Developing and implementing strategies to promote CWC's business verticals and expand its customer base.
  • Creating marketing materials and reaching stakeholders through door-to-door marketing, social media, WhatsApp, and cold calling.

Post Code 04: Young Professional (Marketing & Business Development) - Jaipur

  • Organizing training sessions, workshops, and field visits at CWC warehouses to educate stakeholders about CWC's services.
  • Collecting stakeholder feedback and communicating it to CWC management for continuous improvement.
  • Identifying areas for market expansion and recommending business development strategies for new regions.
  • Setting and tracking sales targets for the respective business vertical, and preparing regular activity reports.
  • Working in coordination with the Regional Marketing Head and Regional Manager of the region, and staying updated on CWC/GoI policies and schemes relevant to e-commerce, logistics, and supply chain operations.

As per the notification, this job description is indicative of the general nature of work and is not an exhaustive list; specific duties may vary based on the Corporation's requirements.

IOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for IOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 must be Citizens of India. Merely applying, being shortlisted, or appearing for document verification and personal interaction does not guarantee an offer of engagement in the Bank.

Educational Qualification

Candidates must hold a Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a University recognized by the Government of India, or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government. The result must be declared on or before 31.07.2026. Candidates registered under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) must have had their graduation result declared between 01.03.2022 and 31.07.2026, both dates inclusive, and must produce mark sheets and provisional or degree certificates when required.

Age Limit

The minimum age is 20 years and the maximum age is 28 years as on the cut-off date of 01.07.2026 for General and EWS category candidates, meaning the date of birth should fall between 01.07.1998 and 01.07.2006, both dates inclusive. Candidates registered under NAPS should be less than 34 years as on the cut-off date, after applicable relaxation.

Category Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe 5 years
Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities 10 years

Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates is allowed on a cumulative basis with only one of the remaining categories of relaxation. To claim age relaxation, candidates must submit the requisite certificate at the time of personal interaction along with original certificates.

The Government share of Rs. 6,150 will be directly credited to the apprentice's bank account through DBT mode. Apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances or benefits.

IOB Apprentice Application Fee 2026-27

The application fee for IOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 must be paid online between 07.07.2026 and 22.07.2026 through the BEEP portal only. The fee is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other engagement process.

IOB Apprentice Selection Process 2026-27

Selection for IOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 will be based on an online examination, a test of the local language wherever applicable, and personal interaction if decided by the Bank. Satisfying the eligibility criteria alone does not guarantee a call for the online examination.

Online Written Examination Pattern

Test Name Number of Questions Marks
General/Financial Awareness 25 25
General English 25 25

The total duration of the examination is 90 minutes. The examination will be conducted online using the candidate's own front camera-enabled desktop, laptop, tablet, or smartphone, and candidates must display the same ID proof uploaded on the apprenticeship portal. Candidates must score a minimum aggregate percentage as decided by the Bank, with a 5 percent relaxation available for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates. There is no minimum qualifying mark for individual subjects.

Test of Local Language

Candidates applying for a particular state must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking, and understanding at least one local language of that state. This test is conducted during document verification after qualifying the written examination. Candidates who have studied the specified local language up to 10th or 12th standard are exempted from this test.

Wait-list

A state-category-wise waitlist will be maintained for one year from the date of the result or the next engagement exercise, whichever is earlier.

Candidates shortlisted for document verification or personal interaction must produce the following documents in original along with self-attested photocopies.

  • Printout of the email from BFSI SSC containing submitted application data
  • Proof of date of birth (birth certificate or SSLC/Std. X certificate with DOB)
  • Photo identity proof such as Passport, Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar, PAN Card, Driving Licence, or Voter's Card
  • Consolidated mark sheets and relevant educational qualification certificates
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed format for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates
  • Non-creamy layer OBC certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026, where applicable
  • Disability certificate in the prescribed format for PwBD candidates
  • Any other relevant documents supporting eligibility

How to Apply for IOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27

Candidates can apply online for IOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 from 07.07.2026 to 20.07.2026 by following the steps below.

  1. Register on the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in or the NAPS portal at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in before applying.
  2. Visit the "Career Opportunities" page on www.bfsissc.com or https://beep.bfsissc.com.
  3. NATS-registered candidates should log in at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php and apply under "Apply against advertised vacancies" for Indian Overseas Bank.
  4. NAPS-registered candidates should visit https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/apprenticeship/opportunity, search "Indian Overseas Bank," click "View," and then "Apply for this Opportunity."
  5. Provide the NATS/NAPS enrolment number while filling the online application form.
  6. Apply for engagement from only one State/UT, preferably the home State/UT.
  7. Pay the requisite application fee/intimation charges online between 07.07.2026 and 22.07.2026.

No other mode of application or payment will be accepted. Applications once submitted cannot be withdrawn, and fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

Important Instructions for IOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27

  • Candidates should not have undergone apprenticeship earlier with IOB or any other organization, or been terminated from apprenticeship training due to their own fault.
  • Candidates with one year or more of training or job experience after completing the educational qualification are not eligible.
  • Apprentices are not treated as "employees" of the Bank and are not entitled to employee benefits.
  • Apprentices are entitled to one day of casual leave per month, totaling 12 days per year, with a maximum of 4 days availed at a time.
  • No Ex-servicemen or Disabled Ex-servicemen shall be engaged as apprentices, and there is no reservation for them in this process.
  • The Bank has no obligation to offer regular employment during or after the apprenticeship period.
  • Furnishing false, incorrect, or tampered information will lead to disqualification or termination, even after engagement.
  • Any request for change of address, email ID, or document verification dates will not be entertained.
  • Any dispute arising out of this recruitment is subject to the sole jurisdiction of courts situated at Chennai.

  • The engagement is at 1 (one) level – Associate.
  • The engagement is purely on a contractual basis.
  • Associates have the legal status of an independent consultant vis-à-vis NHIDCL and shall not be regarded, for any purpose, as a staff member, official, or employee of NHIDCL. Nothing in the individual consultancy contracts or these guidelines establishes an employer-employee or principal-agent relationship between NHIDCL and the Associates.
  • Associates will be engaged for a fixed period of 2 (two) years, which may be extended by 1 (one) year at a time up to a maximum tenure of 3 (three) years, i.e., 2+1 years, for providing high-quality services on specific projects as per the requirement of the verticals/divisions. Continuation beyond the first and subsequent years is contingent on the decision of the Consultants’ Review Committee (CRC).

Terms of Reference (Role & Responsibilities)

The Terms of Reference (ToR) include the outputs to be delivered and the functions to be performed, which shall be specific, measurable, attainable, results-based, and time-bound. An indicative ToR for Associates (SSGS) is as follows; detailed ToR will be drawn up by the respective Regional Offices of NHIDCL for which Associates are selected, and this ToR is deemed part of the contract.

  • Project Preparation & Design Appraisal: Assist in the review of feasibility studies, DPRs, alignment plans, and compliance with IRC/MoRTH standards.
  • Construction Supervision & Project Monitoring: Undertake field visits, monitor physical/financial progress, and report on quality, safety, and adherence to specifications.
  • Contract & Documentation Support: Assist in contract management, correspondence, technical notes, and maintenance of project records/MIS.
  • Quality Assurance & Technical Compliance: Review test results, site practices, and ensure compliance with approved drawings and Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs).
  • Post-Construction & O&M Support: Support completion documentation, punch-list closure, and monitoring during the defect liability period.

Induction & Payment

  • There will be an Induction Module of 3 (three) days, which each hired Associate must go through.
  • The Competent Authority may prescribe "Competency Tests" at any time, periodic or otherwise, and Associates are expected to clear these as per the minimum qualifying marks prescribed.
  • All engagements are subject to the successful completion of a Background Verification (BGV) process, which may include verification of the candidate's identity, address, educational and professional qualifications, character antecedents, and any other information deemed necessary by NHIDCL. If the outcome of the BGV is found unsatisfactory at any point – before or after appointment – NHIDCL reserves the right to withdraw or cancel the engagement.

Selection Process

The Hiring Notice directs eligible candidates to apply through the NHIDCL Resource Pool Portal; the notice does not detail a separate written test, and selection proceeds through NHIDCL shortlisting candidates from the Eligible Pool of Applicants for interview, assessment, or other stages, as decided by the Competent Authority based on vacancy availability and operational requirements.

  • For the purpose of this Hiring Notice, the "Eligible Pool of Applicants" means candidates whose applications/profiles for the relevant position are available in the NHIDCL Resource Pool Portal and who satisfy the prescribed educational qualifications, domicile requirements, age criteria, and other eligibility conditions applicable to the position.
  • Candidates who applied for the same position under Hiring Notice No. 05/2025, and whose applications are available in the Resource Pool Portal, need not apply again. Further, candidates who were shortlisted and called for interview pursuant to Hiring Notice No. 05/2025 but were not selected shall also remain eligible for consideration and need not submit a fresh application, subject to their continued inclusion in the Eligible Pool of Applicants and fulfilment of the eligibility conditions prescribed in this Recruitment Notice.
  • NHIDCL may, at its discretion and subject to availability of vacancies, operational requirements, and approval of the Competent Authority, consider, shortlist, and call candidates from the Eligible Pool of Applicants for interview, assessment, or any other stage of selection for present or future requirements under the Scheme – either pursuant to a Recruitment Notice or without issuance of a separate public advertisement, where deemed appropriate.
  • Registration in the Resource Pool Portal or inclusion in the Eligible Pool of Applicants does not confer any right to shortlisting, interview, engagement, or appointment.

How to Apply Online for NHIDCL Associate Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates may apply through the NHIDCL Resource Pool Portal.

  1. Visit the Resource Pool Portal – Go to Apply Here.
  2. Register/Update Profile – Register yourself and submit your application/profile for the relevant position and State/UT, ensuring you meet the domicile, qualification, and age criteria for that position.
  3. Submit Within the Window – Applications must be submitted between 8 July 2026, 10:00 AM, and 5 August 2026, 5:00 PM.

Interested candidates may register themselves on the Resource Pool Portal and update their profile at any time during the year, even if the last date of application for a particular advertisement has already passed. NHIDCL may also issue abridged advertisements directing prospective candidates to register and submit their profiles through the Resource Pool Portal for future requirements.

All correspondence shall be made only via email at [email protected]. Any other mode of correspondence shall not be valid.

Important Instructions

  • Candidates must ensure they meet all eligibility criteria and possess essential qualification recognized by AICTE/UGC/State Technical Boards.
  • Furnishing inaccurate, wrong, incomplete, or misleading information may lead to rejection of the candidature.
  • Candidates must keep their email ID active for one year; no change in the email ID would be allowed.
  • Corrigendum, addendum, or errata will be posted only on NHIDCL's website at www.nhidcl.com, under the heading "Resource Portal".
  • Canvassing or external influence will disqualify the candidate from selection.
  • Candidates should avoid middlemen, recruitment agents/consultants, and fraudulent job promises.
  • All disputes are subject to Delhi High Court jurisdiction, with the English version prevailing for interpretation.
  • Personal information collected during the verification process shall be handled in accordance with applicable laws, rules, and NHIDCL's policies, and used only for the purpose of assessment and verification relevant to the engagement.
  • For General Terms and Conditions of Engagement, candidates should refer to Section 5 of the Scheme for Young Professionals, Expert Professionals, and Empanelment of Persons of Eminence. Provisions of the Scheme shall apply and supersede any contradictory instructions in this Recruitment Notice.

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the CRP SPL-XVI notification 2026 for the recruitment of Specialist Officers (Scale I) across 11 Participating Public Sector Banks. A total of 745 indicative vacancies are available for posts including IT Officer, Agricultural Field Officer, Rajbhasha Adhikari, Law Officer, HR/Personnel Officer, and Marketing Officer. Online registration runs from 01 July 2026 to 21 July 2026, and the recruitment is meant to fill vacancies for the financial year 2027-28.

IBPS CRP SPL-XVI 2026 - Overview

IBPS CRP SPL-XVI Eligibility Criteria 2026

Eligibility for IBPS Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 depends on the specific post applied for, since each role has a distinct educational qualification requirement. Age limits, however, remain uniform across all six posts, with relaxations available for reserved categories.

Age Limit (As on 01.07.2026)

The minimum age required is 20 years and the maximum age is 30 years, meaning candidates must be born not earlier than 02.07.1996 and not later than 01.07.2006.

Category Age Relaxation
SC/ST 5 years
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities 10 years
Ex-Servicemen/Commissioned Officers 5 years

Educational Qualification (As on 21.07.2026)

Post Qualification Required
IT Officer 4-year Engineering/Technology degree in Computer Science/IT/Electronics or related field, OR Postgraduate degree in relevant field, OR Graduate with DOEACC 'B' level
Agricultural Field Officer 4-year degree in Agriculture/Horticulture/Animal Husbandry/Veterinary Science/Dairy Science/Fishery Science or allied subjects
Rajbhasha Adhikari Postgraduate degree in Hindi with English as a subject at graduation, OR PG in Sanskrit with English and Hindi as subjects
Law Officer Bachelor's Degree in Law (LL.B) and enrolled as an advocate with Bar Council
HR/Personnel Officer Graduate and 2-year full-time PG degree/diploma in Personnel Management/HR/Industrial Relations/Social Work/Labour Law
Marketing Officer Graduate and 2-year full-time MBA/MMS/PGDBA/PGDM with specialization in Marketing

For posts other than IT Officer, candidates must also have studied Computer/Information Technology as a subject in High School, College, or Institute, or hold a certificate/diploma/degree in computer operations.

IBPS CRP SPL-XVI Application Fee 2026

The application fee for IBPS Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 varies by category and must be paid online during the registration window. Bank transaction charges for online payment are borne separately by the candidate.

Category Fee (Inclusive of GST)
SC/ST/PwBD ₹175/-
General/EWS/OBC and all others ₹850/-

Payment can be made using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards, Mobile Wallets, or UPI.

IBPS Specialist Officer Selection Process 2026

Selection under IBPS CRP SPL-XVI 2026 follows a three-stage process: Online Preliminary Examination, Online Main Examination, and a Common Interview. Only candidates who clear each stage progress to the next, and the final merit list is based on Main Examination and Interview scores combined.

  1. Online Preliminary Examination – Tentatively in August 2026; candidates must clear individual cut-offs in each of four tests.
  2. Preliminary Result – Declared in September/October 2026.
  3. Online Main Examination – Tentatively in November 2026; scores from this stage alone are used for interview shortlisting and final merit.
  4. Main Exam Result – Declared in November 2026.
  5. Common Interview – Conducted by Participating Banks and coordinated by Nodal Banks in November/December 2026; total 100 marks with minimum qualifying marks of 40% (35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD).
  6. Provisional Allotment – Expected in January 2027, based on merit-cum-preference with an 80:20 weightage between Main Exam and Interview.

Exam Pattern Overview

The Preliminary Exam for IT Officer, Agricultural Field Officer, HR/Personnel Officer, and Marketing Officer consists of 100 questions for 125 marks across English Language, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, and Professional Knowledge, to be completed in 80 minutes. The Main Exam for the same posts carries 150 objective questions for 200 marks plus a Descriptive Paper of 25 marks, totaling 225 marks in 155 minutes. Law Officer and Rajbhasha Adhikari have a similar structure but include General Awareness with Special Reference to Banking Industry in place of Quantitative Aptitude.

There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in objective tests; no penalty applies for unattempted questions.

IBPS CRP SPL-XVI Apply Online 2026

Candidates can apply for IBPS Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 only through the online mode on the official IBPS website; no other application method is accepted. The steps below outline the complete registration and payment process.

  1. Visit the official website www.ibps.in and click on the "CRP SPL" link on the homepage.
  2. Select "Click Here to Apply Online for CRP-Specialist Officers (CRP SPL-XVI)" to open the application form.
  3. Click "Click Here for New Registration" and enter basic details to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  4. Log in again using the provisional credentials to complete the application form.
  5. Upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration, and SSC/SSLC/10th standard certificate as per specifications.
  6. Capture and upload a live photograph via webcam or mobile phone.
  7. Verify all details carefully, since no changes are allowed after clicking "Complete Registration" (except during the 2-day Edit Window).
  8. Pay the applicable application fee online via Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.
  9. Download and print the system-generated application form and e-receipt for future reference.

IBPS Specialist Officer Salary and Pay Scale 2026

Selected candidates under IBPS CRP SPL-XVI will be appointed as Specialist Officers, Scale I, with pay determined by the standard officer pay scale applicable across Participating Banks. Officials are also eligible for allowances and perquisites as per each bank's applicable rules.

IBPS CRP SPL-XVI Document Requirements

Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents along with self-attested photocopies at the time of interview, failing which their candidature can be cancelled. Required documents include the interview call letter, system-generated application printout, proof of date of birth, photo identity proof, educational mark sheets/certificates, and category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD) as applicable, all in prescribed Government of India formats.

OBC candidates must submit a Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026, while EWS candidates need an Income & Asset Certificate valid for the year 2026-27 for financial year 2025-26.

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying for IBPS CRP SPL-XVI

Many candidates lose their chance at IBPS Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 due to avoidable errors during the application process. Being aware of these common mistakes in advance can help ensure a smooth, error-free submission.

  • Applying for multiple posts: A candidate can apply for only one post; multiple applications are summarily rejected.
  • Uploading incorrect photo/signature size: Photos must be 4.5cm × 3.5cm (20-50 KB), and signatures 10-20 KB; oversized or blurred files cause application rejection.
  • Writing the declaration in capital letters: The handwritten declaration must be in the candidate's own handwriting, in English, and NOT in capital letters.
  • Ignoring the Edit Window: Since most fields like Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, and Nationality cannot be edited after submission, double-check all entries before final submission.
  • Missing the fee payment deadline: Applying without completing fee payment within 01.07.2026 to 21.07.2026 renders the form incomplete and invalid.
  • Not retaining photograph copies: Candidates should keep at least 8 copies of the uploaded photograph, as these are required at multiple stages including exam day.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

Sarkari Job Find - Filter by Qualification & State

Not every sarkari job requires a degree. Use the qualification and state filters below to sarkari job find openings that actually match your eligibility, instead of scrolling through listings you don't qualify for.

Sarkari Job for 10th Pass / 12th Pass

Several high-volume recruiters - including Railways (Group D), SSC (MTS, GD), and state police departments - recruit primarily at the 10th pass and 12th pass level. Browse these openings on our 10th & 12th Pass Jobs page.

Sarkari Job for Graduates & Postgraduates

Graduate and postgraduate-level sarkari jobs include SSC CGL, Bank PO, UPSC Civil Services, and various state PCS exams. See qualification-matched listings on our Graduate Jobs page.

State-Wise Sarkari Bharat Job (Bihar, UP, Tamil Nadu, and more)

State government recruitment is listed separately by state, since eligibility and domicile rules vary. Find your state's current openings via our State Government Jobs directory.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया
