How to Apply for RBI Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 (Apply Online)

Candidates can apply for RBI Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 only through the official website www.rbi.org.in between 29 June 2026 and 20 July 2026. The process requires registration, document upload, a live photograph capture, and online fee payment before final submission.

  1. Visit www.rbi.org.in, go to Opportunities@RBI > Current Vacancies > Vacancies, and select "Lateral Recruitment of Site Engineers on Full-Time Contract Basis in RBI."
  2. Click "Online Application Form" and select "Click here for New Registration"; enter your name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  3. Log in and fill in personal, educational, and experience details, using "Save and Next" to verify entries before final submission.
  4. Upload your scanned photograph (20-50KB, JPG), signature (10-20KB, JPG), left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the prescribed specifications.
  5. Capture and upload a live photograph using a webcam or mobile phone QR scan during registration.
  6. Upload supporting PDF documents (20KB-500KB each) for age, category, educational qualification, and work experience proof.
  7. Click "Complete Registration" only after verifying all details, since no changes are allowed afterward.
  8. Proceed to the "Payment" tab and pay the applicable fee via debit card, credit card, net banking, IMPS, or mobile wallet, then click "Submit."

Candidates should submit only one application per post; in case of multiple submissions, only the last completed application with the higher Registration ID (RID) will be considered, and fees paid against one RID cannot be adjusted to another.

RBI Site Engineer Document Requirements 2026

Candidates applying for RBI Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 must upload several documents in PDF format during the online application process, with each clearly supporting their claims for age, category, qualification, and experience. Missing or unclear documents can lead to rejection at the verification stage.

  • Proof of age (PDF format)
  • Category certificate for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/EWS, where applicable, dated on or before the closing date
  • Educational qualification documents (B.Tech/M.Tech certificates and mark sheets)
  • Up-to-date Experience Certificate clearly stating nature of duties, dates, duration, level/position, and responsibilities
  • Scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, 20-50KB, JPG/JPEG)
  • Scanned signature in black ink (10-20KB, JPG/JPEG)
  • Left thumb impression (20-50KB) and handwritten declaration in English (50-100KB)
  • Live photograph captured via webcam or mobile during registration

OBC candidates must specifically produce a Non-Creamy Layer certificate based on income for FY 2023-24, 2024-25, or 2025-26, issued on or after 01 April 2026 but before the closing date of 20 July 2026.

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying for RBI Site Engineer 2026

Many candidates risk rejection due to avoidable errors during the RBI Site Engineer online application process. Reviewing these common mistakes beforehand can help ensure your application is processed without issues.

  • Writing the declaration in capital letters or another language: The handwritten declaration must be in English, in the candidate's own handwriting, and not in capital letters — non-compliant declarations make the application invalid.
  • Expecting age relaxation: Unlike many government recruitments, RBI has explicitly stated no age relaxation is available for any category in this notification, so candidates must meet the 40-65 year window strictly.
  • Submitting multiple incomplete applications: If multiple applications are filed for the same post, only the last completed one with the higher Registration ID is considered, and the fee from the earlier RID is not adjusted.
  • Uploading documents in the wrong format: Photograph and signature must be JPG/JPEG, while all other supporting documents must be in PDF format within the specified size limits.
  • Not informing current employer: Government/PSU employees must submit an undertaking confirming they have informed their employer in writing about applying, or their candidature may be rejected.
  • Ignoring OBC NCL certificate dating: OBC candidates need a Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued on or after 01 April 2026 — older certificates based on different financial years won't be accepted.

Roles and Responsibilities of Cooperative Intern

Candidates applying for the MSC Bank Cooperative Intern Programme 2026 will be assigned substantive responsibilities at the grassroots level. The intern is not merely an observer - they are expected to coordinate with Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) and other primary cooperatives, and prepare weekly progress reports for the Ministry of Cooperation. This is a full-time programme, and interns must observe the working hours of the concerned bank.

Key duties include:

  • Coordinating with Primary Agricultural Credit Society (PACS) and other primary cooperatives to provide guidance for implementing Ministry of Cooperation initiatives
  • Solving day-to-day problems faced by PACS in computerisation, preparation of business plans, projects, financing issues, and various approvals
  • Preparing and sharing weekly status reports on the implementation of Ministry of Cooperation initiatives, in coordination with the State Cooperative Bank and District Central Cooperative Banks

Final selection is at the discretionary power of the Bank/Selection Committee. There is no written examination mentioned in the notification.

Step 1 - Application Screening: The bank shortlists candidates from the offline applications received based on eligibility criteria.

Step 2 - Interview: Only shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview. The exact date and venue of the interview are communicated to shortlisted candidates directly.

Step 3 - Final Selection: The Selection Committee's decision on final selection is discretionary and binding.

How to Apply Offline - MSC Bank Cooperative Intern Apply 2026

The MSC Bank Cooperative Intern Apply 2026 process is entirely offline - there is no online application portal for this recruitment. Candidates must download the prescribed application form (Annexure-I) from the bank's website, fill it in their own handwriting, attach all supporting documents, and physically submit it to the bank's Mumbai head office before the deadline. Applications submitted after 5:15 PM on 10 July 2026 will not be accepted.

Step-by-step application process:

  1. Visit the official MSC Bank website at https://msc.bank.in/career and download the Application Form (Annexure-I)
  2. Fill the application form in your own handwriting with all required details including name, address, date of birth, educational qualifications, MBA/PGDM specialisation, computer proficiency, work experience, and references
  3. Affix a recent passport-size photograph in the designated space and sign in the signature box
  4. Attach self-attested photocopies of all relevant qualification certificates, computer proficiency certificate, and experience certificates (if any)
  5. Provide details of two references - bankers, professionals, or government officials who are residents of India, holders of responsible positions, and not related to you
  6. Place the completed application and all documents in a sealed envelope
  7. Write "Application for the post of Cooperative Intern" on the envelope
  8. Submit or send the sealed envelope to:
    The Joint Manager (OSD), HRD&M Department, The Maharashtra State Cooperative Bank Ltd., Sir Vithaldas Thackersey Memorial Building, 9, Maharashtra Chamber of Commerce Lane, Fort, Mumbai – 400001
  9. Ensure delivery on or before 10 July 2026 till 5:15 PM

Documents Required - MSC Bank Cooperative Intern 2026

Candidates must enclose self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents along with the application form (Annexure-I). Submitting incorrect or false information makes the candidate liable for disqualification and, if appointed, for dismissal from service without notice.

Required documents to enclose with the application:

  • Passport-size photograph (affixed on the form)
  • Proof of date of birth
  • Marksheets and certificates from Matriculation through MBA/PGDM (including Bachelor's degree)
  • MBA/PGDM degree or provisional certificate confirming successful completion
  • Computer proficiency certificate (MS-CIT or equivalent)
  • Any additional professional qualification certificates (JAIIB/CAIIB, certifications, etc.)
  • Work experience certificates, if applicable
  • Details of two references (bankers/professionals/government officials, non-relatives)
  • PAN Card copy
  • Aadhaar Card copy

Important Terms and Conditions for MSC Bank Cooperative Interns

Candidates must clearly understand that the MSC Bank Cooperative Internship 2026 is not a job offer and does not create any right or claim for regular employment with MSC Bank or any associated institution. The internship can be discontinued at any time without payment of financial benefit if the intern's performance is unsatisfactory or if the intern is absent without authorisation. Interns are also bound by strict confidentiality obligations regarding bank documents, policies, and business plans.

Key terms to note:

  • This is a full-time internship programme - interns must observe bank working hours
  • The internship may be terminated at any time without assigning reasons
  • Interns must not interact with media (print/electronic/social media) or represent the bank without express permission
  • Interns must maintain confidentiality of all documents, reports, and information received during the internship - violation entails legal consequences
  • No intern can post work-related content on social media without written permission from competent authority
  • The internship confers no right to employment with the bank or associated institutions

Troubleshooting and Common Mistakes to Avoid

Since the MSC Bank Cooperative Intern application process is entirely offline, several common errors can lead to rejection. Being aware of these before submitting your application saves time and avoids disappointment.

  • Applying while still pursuing MBA/PGDM: The notification is clear - candidates currently pursuing the 2-year MBA/PGDM are not eligible. Only those who have already completed the degree should apply.
  • Missing the 5:15 PM deadline on 10 July 2026: This is not a midnight deadline - it is 5:15 PM sharp. Applications received even minutes after 5:15 PM on 10 July will not be accepted. Plan for early submission or courier delivery with tracking.
  • Not filling the form in own handwriting: The application form (Annexure-I) must be handwritten by the candidate. Typed or printed personal details in the form may be grounds for rejection.
  • Not mentioning MBA/PGDM specialisation clearly: The form has a checkbox for specialisation (Marketing Management, Cooperative Management, Agri Business Management, Rural Development Management). Leaving this blank creates ambiguity.
  • Omitting computer proficiency certificate: Computer proficiency is listed as an essential qualification. Candidates who do not enclose proof of MS-CIT or equivalent certification risk rejection.
  • Providing relatives as references: The notification explicitly states that references must not be relations. Providing a family member as a reference is a disqualifying error.
  • Wrong envelope superscription: The envelope must be labelled "Application for the post of Cooperative Intern." Using any other labelling or no labelling may result in the envelope being misrouted.
  • Submitting only the form without supporting documents: Self-attested photocopies of all qualification certificates must accompany the form. An incomplete application without supporting documents will not be processed.

Nature of Employment: Fixed Term, Not Permanent

Candidates exploring this opportunity should understand that these are not regular permanent bank jobs. Bank of Baroda has clearly defined the engagement structure for these IT positions.

Selected candidates will be engaged as an Officer on Fixed Term Employment for an initial period of 3 years from the date of joining. This can be renewed or extended for an additional maximum of 2 years, subject to satisfactory performance and at the Bank's discretion. The engagement automatically ends on expiry unless renewed, and in any case, it remains valid only till the candidate reaches a maximum age of 60 years or the end of the fixed term, whichever comes first.

Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for these IT leadership roles is assessed as on the cut-off date, and the Bank has linked position-specific qualification and experience details separately for each post rather than listing them within the main notification.

The detailed educational qualification and work experience criteria for each of the 5 posts - VP Head-AI, VP Head Platform Engineering, DVP Dy. Head Cloud CoE, DVP Dy. Head IT Infrastructure, and DVP Dy. Head Platform Engineering - are provided through separate position-specific links on the Bank's official notification, since each senior IT role has its own distinct skill and experience requirements.

General Eligibility Conditions

  • Eligibility is reckoned as on the cut-off date of 01-06-2026.
  • Post-qualification experience of less than six months in any organization as on 01-06-2026 will not be counted toward eligibility, unless that experience is part of the candidate's current employment.
  • Candidates must be a Citizen of India, or fall under specific categories such as a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who settled in India before 1 January 1962, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from select countries with the intention of permanently settling in India.
  • OBC candidates falling under the "creamy layer" are not entitled to OBC reservation or age relaxation and must apply under the General category.

CIBIL Score and Credit History Requirement

Unlike most government job notifications, this Bank of Baroda recruitment includes a specific financial credibility check. This is an important and somewhat unique eligibility condition candidates must be aware of.

Candidates must maintain a satisfactory credit history, and a minimum CIBIL score of 680 or above is required at the time of joining. Candidates who have defaulted on loan repayment or credit card dues, or against whom adverse reports exist from CIBIL or other external credit rating agencies, will be deemed ineligible for appointment. The Bank reserves the right to reject candidature at any stage, including after joining, if the credit profile is found unsatisfactory.

Remuneration and Location of Posting

Salary for these roles is not fixed on a standard pay scale, unlike typical government recruitment. This section explains how pay is determined and where selected candidates will be posted.

Remuneration will be offered based on the candidate's qualifications, experience, overall suitability, last drawn salary, and market benchmark - there is no fixed pay scale mentioned in the notification. The location of posting is Mumbai or Hyderabad, though selected candidates remain liable for transfer anywhere in India as per the Bank's requirement.

Selection Process

Selection for these IT leadership posts goes beyond a standard written exam, with the Bank assessing multiple professional parameters. No fixed exam date or selection timeline has been announced in the notification.

The selection process may include an online test, a psychometric test, or any other test the Bank deems suitable, followed by an Interview or multiple interviews. The Bank may shortlist applications based on criteria such as suitability for the role, depth of prior experience, leadership exposure, domain expertise, professional certifications, and exposure to regulatory or compliance frameworks. The minimum qualifying mark for the Personal Interview (PI) is 60% for UR category and 55% for Reserved category candidates.

How to Apply Online for Bank of Baroda IT Recruitment 2026

Applications for these posts can only be submitted online, with no other mode accepted. Here is the step-by-step process candidates need to follow.

  1. Visit the Bank's official website and go to the Career section → Current Opportunities page.
  2. Register online using the application format enabled for this recruitment.
  3. Fill in the online application form carefully, since no changes are allowed after clicking SUBMIT.
  4. Upload your Bio-data, scanned photograph, signature, and supporting eligibility documents as per the prescribed specifications.
  5. Verify all entered details, including name, category, date of birth, and post applied for, before final submission.
  6. Submit the application well before 10-07-2026 to avoid last-minute website load issues.
  7. Save the acknowledgement number generated on the portal and check your registered email for confirmation - registration is complete only once this acknowledgement is received.

Documents and Upload Specifications

Bank of Baroda requires specific documents to be uploaded at the time of application, each with strict file format and size requirements. Getting these specifications wrong is a common reason applications get stuck.

Documents to Upload (Application Stage)

  • Resume (PDF)
  • DOB Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
  • Educational Certificates: relevant mark-sheets/certificates, scanned in a single PDF file
  • Work experience certificates, if applicable (PDF)
  • Caste/Category Certificate, if applicable (PDF)
  • PWD certificate, if applicable (PDF)

Photograph and Signature Specifications

  • Photograph: recent passport-style colour picture, dimensions 200 x 230 pixels, file size between 20kb–50kb.
  • Signature: signed in black ink on white paper, dimensions 140 x 60 pixels, file size between 10kb–20kb.
  • Document files: must be in PDF format, A4 page size, and not exceeding 500 KB each.

Documents Required at Interview Stage

At the time of interview, candidates must produce originals along with self-attested photocopies of documents including the call letter printout, system-generated application printout, date of birth proof, photo identity proof, mark sheets and degree certificates, and category certificates where applicable. Notably, a Ration Card will not be accepted as valid identity proof for this recruitment.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

Given the strict, no-correction-after-submission policy of this recruitment, small errors can have a big impact. The following points can help candidates avoid losing their candidature.

  • Do not submit the application without double-checking every field - no changes are allowed once you click SUBMIT.
  • Do not upload a photograph or signature outside the specified pixel and file-size limits, as the system will reject non-compliant files.
  • Do not assume your credit history is irrelevant - a CIBIL score below 680 or any adverse credit report can make you ineligible.
  • Do not delay applying until the last day; server load near the 10-07-2026 deadline can prevent successful submission.
  • Do not carry a Ration Card as your only ID proof for the interview - it will not be accepted.
  • Do not forget to check the position-specific eligibility link for your chosen post, since detailed qualifications differ by role.

North Western Railway's Rail Bharti Cell (RRC), Jaipur has issued an important notice for candidates who were provisionally shortlisted for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) under Centralized Employment Notice (CEN) No. 08/2024 for various Level-1 posts. As per the official notice dated 8 July 2026, the Physical Efficiency Test for 2,373 provisionally shortlisted candidates will be conducted from 29 July 2026 to 1 August 2026 at Ajmer. This article breaks down everything candidates need to know - the PET schedule, venue, eligibility standards, and how to download the e-call letter.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

What Is the RRC Jaipur PET Notice About?

This section explains the core purpose of the notice released by the Railway Recruitment Cell, Jaipur, and who it applies to.

The notice (Reference No. 740E/RRC/Level-1/CEN 08/2024/PET, dated 08.07.2026) informs candidates that the result of the Computer-Based Test (CBT) for provisionally shortlisted candidates for the PET under CEN 08/2024 (Level-1 posts) has been declared. This result was released by the Railway Recruitment Board on 1 July 2026 and has been published on the official websites of both RRC Jaipur and RRB Ajmer.

RRB Group D PET 2026: Key Dates and Details

This section summarizes the most important facts from the notice in an easy-to-scan format.

Particular Details
Notice Number 740E/RRC/Level-1/CEN 08/2024/PET
Notice Date 08 July 2026
CEN Number CEN 08/2024 (Level-1 posts)
CBT Result Declared On 01 July 2026
Number of Shortlisted Candidates 2,373
PET Exam Dates 29 July 2026 to 01 August 2026
PET Venue G.L.O. Ground, A.D.S.A. Stadium, Near DRM Office, Mall Road, Ajmer, Pin 305001
Conducting Body Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Jaipur / North Western Railway
Official Website rrcjaipur.in
e-Call Letter Delivery Via SMS and email to registered mobile number/email ID

Where Will the RRB Group D PET Be Conducted?

This section covers the exact exam venue for candidates traveling to attend the Physical Efficiency Test.

The PET will be held at the G.L.O. Ground, A.D.S.A. Stadium, Near DRM Office, Mall Road, Ajmer, Pin Code 305001. Candidates are advised to plan their travel to Ajmer in advance, keeping in mind the exam window of 29 July to 1 August 2026.

How to Download the RRB Group D PET e-Call Letter

This section explains how shortlisted candidates will receive information about their PET call letter.

According to the notice, provisionally shortlisted candidates will receive an SMS and email alert on their registered mobile number and email address once the e-call letter is available for download. Candidates should:

  • Regularly check the registered mobile number and email ID used at the time of application.
  • Visit the official website rrcjaipur.in frequently for updates.
  • Download the e-call letter as soon as the SMS/email notification is received.

RRB Group D PET 2026: Physical Efficiency Test Standards

This section details the exact physical fitness benchmarks male and female candidates must clear in the PET, as specified in the official notice.

The Physical Efficiency Test evaluates candidates on weight-lifting and carrying ability along with a timed 1000-meter run. The qualifying standards differ for male and female candidates, as shown below.

PET Standards for Male Candidates

  • Lift a 35 kg weight and carry it for 100 meters in a single attempt within 2 minutes.
  • AND run a distance of 1000 meters in a single attempt within 4 minutes 15 seconds.

PET Standards for Female Candidates

PET Standard Male Candidates Female Candidates
Weight to Lift & Carry 35 kg 20 kg
Carrying Distance 100 meters 100 meters
Time Limit for Carrying 2 minutes 2 minutes
Running Distance 1000 meters 1000 meters
Time Limit for Running 4 minutes 15 seconds 5 minutes 40 seconds
Number of Attempts Allowed Single chance Single chance

Both the weight-carrying task and the running task must be completed successfully; candidates must clear both components to qualify. For further detailed information on PET rules, candidates should refer to para 14.02 of the official CEN 08/2024 notification, which is annexed to this notice.

Important Advisory: Beware of Fraudulent Agents

This section reproduces the official fraud-warning advisory issued alongside the PET notice, which candidates should take seriously.

The Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC) has issued a strong caution to all candidates:

  • RRC has not authorized any agent or coaching institute to act on its behalf for recruitment purposes.
  • Candidates should be alert to individuals or organizations making false promises of securing a railway job through improper or unethical means.
  • Selection is made purely on merit.
  • Candidates found trying to influence the RRC directly or indirectly will have their candidature cancelled, and legal action may be taken against them.

RITES Recruitment 2026 has been announced by RITES Limited, a Government of India Enterprise, for the engagement of Individual Consultants in bridge design and design review roles. A total of 5 positions are available across four categories (VC No. YP/63/26 to YP/66/26), all located in Kolkata, West Bengal, with monthly remuneration ranging from Rs 2,00,000 to Rs 2,25,000. Interested and eligible civil engineering professionals can apply online through the official RITES website, www.rites.com, from 6 July 2026 to 26 July 2026.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

This article covers the complete RITES Recruitment 2026 notification, including vacancy details, eligibility criteria, salary, important dates, selection process, required documents, and the step-by-step online application procedure.

RITES Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026 Overview

RITES Limited is a multi-disciplinary engineering and consultancy organisation that provides services across transport infrastructure, buildings, and related technologies. Through this notification, RITES Ltd invites applications from experienced civil engineering professionals for engagement as Individual Consultants on a CV-based, contractual basis.

RITES Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

The link for online participation will be shared with candidates on their registered email ID or official chat group.

RITES Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for any of the four RITES Individual Consultant categories must satisfy the educational qualification, experience, and age criteria described below. Eligibility is reckoned as on the last date of application submission, i.e., 26 July 2026.

Educational Qualification

All four categories require a B.E. or B.Tech degree in Civil Engineering. Where a specialisation is claimed as part of the qualifying degree, candidates must submit a certificate from their university or institution clearly specifying that specialisation.

Work Experience

  • All categories require a total of 7 years of post-qualification experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of specific experience in bridge design, modelling, and analysis is required, using software such as MIDAS, Sofistik, or STAAD depending on the category.
  • Relevant project experience includes major river bridges, ROBs, flyovers, underpasses, and grade separators on highway projects.

Age Limit

The upper age limit for all four categories under RITES Recruitment 2026 is 60 years. No extension of engagement will be given beyond the age of 65 years, even for consultants who are subsequently granted annual extensions.

Applicable Income Tax will be deducted at source, and GST, where applicable, will be admissible to the consultant. If the contract exceeds one year, remuneration may be reviewed annually based on the escalation received in the client's fee.

RITES Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

There is no application fee for any of the posts under RITES Recruitment 2026. The fee for all categories is Nil.

RITES Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for RITES Individual Consultant posts consists of the following stages:

  1. Online Application: Candidates submit their application through the RITES career portal.
  2. Document Scrutiny/Verification: Eligible candidates are provisionally allowed to appear for document scrutiny, where educational and experience claims are verified against original documents.
  3. Interview: Shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview, where they are evaluated on technical skills, subject knowledge, experience, and communication and interpersonal skills. The mode of selection is Interview only.

Following the interview, results (Suitable/Not Found Suitable) will be uploaded on the RITES website along with the post name, registration number, and candidate name as recommended by the selection committee. Since the engagement is for deployment at a client site, an offer letter will be issued only after the client approves the shortlisted candidate's CV, and actual deployment remains subject to project award and company requirement.

Documents Required for RITES Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026

Candidates must carry self-attested photocopies along with originals of the following documents (in chronological order) for document verification/interview:

  • One passport-size photograph
  • High School certificate as proof of date of birth
  • Certificates and mark sheets of all academic and professional qualifications (10th, 12th, Diploma/Graduation/Post-Graduation, as applicable)
  • Experience certificates from previous employers supporting claims made in the application
  • Proof of identity and address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving Licence, Aadhaar Card, etc.)
  • PAN Card
  • Proof of the different periods of experience claimed, if applicable
  • Any other supporting documents

For currently employed candidates, an experience certificate or joining letter along with the last three months' salary slips, or the latest Form 16, must be produced to establish continuity of employment. A checklist (Annexure-A) must also be filled in and submitted at the time of document verification.

How to Apply for RITES Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official RITES website at www.rites.com and go to the Career section.
  2. Check the eligibility criteria carefully before applying, as eligibility is the candidate's own responsibility.
  3. Fill in the online registration form with accurate personal, educational, and experience details.
  4. Note down the system-generated Registration Number for all future correspondence with RITES.
  5. Carefully fill in identity proof details, ensuring the same document is available for later verification stages.
  6. Upload clear and visible scanned copies of all required documents.
  7. Submit the application. Note that applications cannot be altered once submitted.
  8. Print and sign a copy of the submitted application form, and carry it along with self-attested photocopies and original documents at the time of document verification/interview.

Candidates can apply for any number of vacancies but must ensure a valid email ID is used, since RITES will not be responsible for bounced emails. Hard copies of documents should not be sent by post or courier.

Important Instructions for RITES Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026

  • Merely submitting an application or documents does not guarantee an interview call or selection.
  • RITES reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify, or alter the selection process at any stage without notice.
  • The number of vacancies may vary from what is advertised.
  • Candidates currently employed can join RITES only after being properly relieved from their parent organisation.
  • Furnishing false information or suppressing material facts can lead to cancellation of candidature, even after engagement.
  • Any corrigendum or addendum will be published only on www.rites.com; candidates should check the website regularly.
  • No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview, or for joining or completing the assignment.
  • Retired government servants can be engaged only through a competitive process, for specific tasks and duration, and not against regular vacant posts.
  • Queries, if any, should be sent only to [email protected] along with the VC number, registration/roll number, candidate's full name in block letters, and a valid email address.

CMRL Recruitment 2026 notification has been officially released by Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL) under Employment Notification No. CMRL/HR/CON/DEP/04/2026 dated 01-07-2026. CMRL is inviting applications from qualified and experienced professionals for the posts of Chief General Manager (CGM), General Manager (GM), Joint General Manager (JGM - Architect), Deputy General Manager (DGM - Finance & Accounts), and Manager (Architect) on a contract or deputation basis. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official CMRL careers portal on or before 20 July 2026.

CMRL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details and Pay Scale

The CMRL Recruitment 2026 drive covers a total of 7 vacancies across five post categories. The table below lists the number of posts, consolidated monthly pay, and maximum age for each post.

CMRL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

CMRL has laid out separate eligibility criteria for candidates coming from Government organizations, Metro/PSU organizations, and the Private Sector. A summary is given below.

Chief General Manager (Electrical Systems)

  • Govt Organization: Officer with 5 years' service in Senior Administrative Grade (SAG) in Railways/equivalent in GoI, or 5 years as Chief Engineer in State Govt organizations.
  • Metro/PSU: Minimum 25 years post-qualification executive experience with at least 3 years as GM in IDA pay scale Rs. 1,20,000-2,80,000 or equivalent.
  • Private Sector: Minimum 25 years post-qualification executive experience with at least 3 years in top management reporting directly to a Director or Board, in a company with project size of at least Rs. 500 crore or turnover of at least Rs. 100 crore in the last 3 years.

Chief General Manager (Rolling Stock)

  • Govt Organization: IRSEE officer with 5 years' service in SAG in Railways/equivalent, or 5 years as Chief Engineer in State Govt organizations.
  • Metro/PSU and Private Sector: Same experience criteria as above (25 years experience, 3 years as GM/equivalent top management).

General Manager (Electrical Systems / Rolling Stock)

  • Govt Organization: Officer working in SAG in Railways/equivalent, or as Chief Engineer in State Govt organizations.
  • Metro/PSU: Minimum 20 years experience with at least 3 years as AGM in IDA pay scale Rs. 1,00,000-2,60,000 or equivalent.
  • Private Sector: Minimum 20 years experience with at least 3 years in top management (equivalent to AGM in PSU), reporting to Director/Board.

Joint General Manager (Architect)

  • Govt Organization: Officer in Junior Administrative Grade (JAG) in Railways/equivalent, or Executive Engineer (EE) cadre in State Govt with minimum 15 years' experience.
  • Metro/PSU: Minimum 15 years experience with at least 4 years as DGM in IDA pay scale Rs. 80,000-2,20,000 or equivalent.
  • Private Sector: Minimum 15 years experience with at least 4 years in senior management (equivalent to DGM in PSU).

Deputy General Manager (Finance & Accounts)

  • Govt Organization: Officer with 3 years' service in Senior Time Scale (STS) in Railways/equivalent, or Chief Accounts Officer (CAO) cadre in State Govt with minimum 13 years' experience.
  • Metro/PSU: Minimum 13 years experience with at least 4 years as Manager in IDA pay scale Rs. 70,000-2,00,000 or equivalent.
  • Private Sector: Minimum 13 years experience with at least 4 years in middle management (equivalent to Manager in PSU).

Manager (Architect)

  • Govt Organization: Officer in Senior Time Scale (STS) in Railways/equivalent, or Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE) cadre in State Govt with 7 years' experience.
  • Metro/PSU: Minimum 7 years experience with at least 4 years as DM in IDA pay scale Rs. 60,000-1,80,000 or equivalent.
  • Private Sector: Minimum 7 years experience with at least 4 years in middle management (equivalent to DM in PSU), in a company with project size of at least Rs. 200 crore or turnover of at least Rs. 50 crore in the last 3 years.

CMRL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The CMRL selection process for these posts consists of two stages:

  1. Interview: Candidates are assessed on knowledge, skills, comprehension, attitude, and aptitude.
  2. Medical Examination: The first medical examination is free of cost, borne by CMRL. If a candidate requests an extension for joining, the cost of the second medical examination is borne by the candidate. Travel expenses for the medical test are borne by the candidate. Candidates who fail the medical test are not offered alternative employment.

Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview; merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee an interview call. CMRL reserves the right to shortlist candidates and to relax or tighten eligibility standards based on the response received.

CMRL Recruitment 2026 Documents Required

Candidates must upload self-attested copies of the following documents online:

  • Recent passport-size photograph (JPEG/PNG, max 2MB)
  • Age proof (Birth Certificate / 10th Standard Certificate)
  • Community Certificate
  • Educational qualification certificates (10th, 12th, Diploma, Graduation, Post-Graduation)
  • Experience certificates (present and previous employment)
  • NOC / Proper Channel letter (for Govt/PSU applicants)
  • Application fee payment proof (for contract type)
  • Detailed Resume / Bio-data / CV
  • Ex-Servicemen proof (if applicable)
  • Disability Certificate (if applicable)
  • Last 5 years' ACRs, duly attested (for deputation posts only)
  • Vigilance clearance and Integrity Certificate (for deputation posts only)
  • Proforma Certificate from current organization's HR (for deputation posts only)
  • Proof of project size / turnover of the company (for private sector applicants only)
  • Any other relevant certificates

How to Apply Online for CMRL Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must apply only through the official CMRL career portal. No hard copy or paper applications will be accepted. Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official CMRL career portal at careers.chennaimetrorail.org.
  2. Register on the portal using a valid email ID. This email ID will be used for all further correspondence.
  3. Check your registered email for a verification link and click "Verify" to authenticate your email ID.
  4. Log in to the CMRL career page after verification.
  5. Fill in all required details in each section of the application form.
  6. Upload all requisite self-attested documents as listed in the notification.
  7. Pay the applicable application fee (for contract posts) and upload the payment proof.
  8. Review all details carefully and submit the application before the last date, 20 July 2026.

Candidates already employed in a Government or PSU organization must apply through the proper channel and email their application to [email protected], and must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview.

CMRL Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Age, qualification, and experience will be considered as on 01-07-2026.
  • Contract appointments are initially for 2 years, extendable based on performance and requirement. Deputation is initially for 3 years, extendable up to 5 years.
  • Contract employees may be considered for IDA Pay Scale after satisfactory completion of 2 years, subject to CMRL policy.
  • Additional benefits include Medical and Personal Accident Insurance, Life Insurance, Mobile Phone reimbursement, SIM Card, and other admissible allowances as per CMRL HR policy.
  • Higher remuneration or a higher post may be offered based on experience, interview performance, and qualifications.
  • Incomplete applications or those without relevant supporting documents will be rejected outright.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
  • Candidates attempting to influence the selection process will be summarily rejected and disqualified from future CMRL recruitments.
  • CMRL reserves the right to withdraw, cancel, curtail, or increase the number of vacancies at any time without prior notice.
  • All recruitment updates will be published only on the official CMRL website, so candidates should check it regularly.

Objections submitted after 12th July 2026 or without supporting evidence are unlikely to be considered, based on standard FRI practice for prior recruitment cycles, though this has not been separately confirmed for the current notice.

If a candidate disagrees with any answer given in the provisional key, GPSSB allows objections to be submitted online only, within the specified deadline. This section explains the complete objection submission process along with important rules.

Important Rules for Raising Objections

  • Objections must be submitted online only. Offline submissions, in-person visits to the office, or objections sent through any other medium will not be considered.
  • Only candidates who actually appeared for the CBRT exam are eligible to raise online objections.
  • A candidate can raise objections for more than one question if required.
  • Objections must be submitted strictly according to the Question ID mentioned in the candidate's own Provisional Answer Key cum Response Sheet.
  • Once an objection is submitted, it cannot be edited later, so candidates should review carefully before final submission.

Step-by-Step Process to Submit an Objection

  1. After logging in, click on the Objection Form tab.
  2. Click on the "Click here to raise objection" button.
  3. Carefully read all on-screen instructions before proceeding.
  4. Fill in the required details, including Confirmation Number, Roll Number, Applicant Name, Subject Name, Test Date, Shift, Question ID, language in which the question was answered, and type of objection.
  5. Choose whether you want to add remarks, and if yes, mention your reason clearly in English only.
  6. Upload supporting documents to justify your objection.
  7. Click Submit to complete the objection process.

Document Requirements for Objection Submission

GPSSB requires candidates to support their objections with valid reference material. This section outlines the accepted document format and content requirements.

  • Upload a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 3 reference documents per objection.
  • Reference documents should clearly mention the Book Name, Publication, Author's Name, Edition, and Year of Release.
  • Accepted file formats are PDF, JPG, or JPEG only.
  • Maximum file size allowed per document is 400 KB.
  • Documents must be clear and readable; objections without valid proof or reference may be discarded.

UPTET Answer Key 2026 - Overview

Before downloading the answer key or raising an objection, candidates should check the key details of this update at a glance. The table below summarises the exam, the authority, and the important dates related to the UPTET Answer Key 2026.

Particulars Details
Exam Name Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test (UPTET) 2026

Login Credentials Required 10-digit Roll Number and Date of Birth (DDMMYYYY)

What Is the UPTET Answer Key 2026?

The UPTET Answer Key 2026 is the official list of correct answers for all 150 questions asked in Paper 1 and Paper 2 of the UPTET exam. Since the exam is conducted across multiple shifts, UPESSC releases the key separately for each question booklet series (Set A, B, C, D) so that candidates can match answers exactly as per their own paper.

  • The key is first released in provisional form to allow candidates to raise objections.
  • After reviewing all objections, UPESSC will publish the final answer key, which will be used to prepare the UPTET Result 2026.
  • Separate keys are issued for Paper 1 (Class 1–5, Primary Level) and Paper 2 (Class 6–8, Upper Primary Level).

UPTET Paper 1 vs Paper 2 Answer Key

Candidates should download the answer key that matches the paper and booklet series they attempted. The table below explains the difference between the two.

Paper Level Total Questions
Paper 1 Primary Level (Class 1 to 5) 150
Paper 2 Upper Primary Level (Class 6 to 8) 150

How to Download UPTET Answer Key 2026 Online?

Candidates can download the UPTET Answer Key 2026 directly from the official UPESSC portal by logging in with their roll number and date of birth. Follow the steps below to download the correct set without confusion.

  • Visit the official website, upessc.up.gov.in, or the direct answer key portal.
  • Log in using your 10-digit Roll Number and Date of Birth (in DDMMYYYY format).
  • Click on the "UPTET Provisional Answer Key 2026" link on the homepage.
  • Select your paper Paper 1 or Paper 2.
  • Choose the booklet series code that matches your question paper (Set A, B, C, or D).
  • Open the PDF and match it against your OMR response sheet.
  • Download and save a copy of the answer key PDF for future reference.

Alos Read: UPSSSC Assistant Boring Technician Admit Card 2026

How to Raise an Objection Against the UPTET Answer Key?

The objection process requires candidates to log in, select the disputed question, and upload supporting proof before final submission. The steps below outline the complete process.

  • Visit the official objection portal at upessc.net (Question Challenge link).
  • Log in using your Roll Number and Date of Birth.
  • Select your question booklet set and language stream.
  • Click on "File Objections" after reading the instructions.
  • Choose the specific question number you want to challenge.
  • Select what you believe is the correct answer and add remarks.
  • Upload supporting proof from NCERT or SCERT textbooks.
  • Submit the objection and save the confirmation receipt.

Is There an Objection Fee for UPTET Answer Key 2026?

Most reports indicate that UPESSC charges an objection fee of approximately ₹500 per question, which is refundable if the objection is accepted after expert review. However, this fee is not explicitly confirmed in the official notification, so candidates are advised to verify the exact amount on the objection portal before submitting a challenge.

How to Calculate Your Score Using the UPTET Answer Key?

Since the UPTET marking scheme is fixed and there is no negative marking, candidates can easily estimate their probable score by matching their OMR sheet with the correct answer key.

  • Total Questions: 150
  • Total Marks: 150
  • Correct Answer: +1 mark
  • Incorrect or Unattempted Answer: 0 marks
  • Formula: Total Score = Total Number of Correct Answers

Steps to Calculate Your Probable UPTET Score

  • Download the answer key PDF matching your booklet series.
  • Compare each answer with your OMR response sheet.
  • Count the total number of correct answers.
  • Do not deduct marks for wrong or unattempted questions.
  • Your estimated score equals the total number of correct answers.

Also Read: UPSSSC PWD Shikshak Samvarg Mukhya Pariksha Admit Card 2026

What Happens After the Objection Window Closes?

Once the objection window closes on 14 July 2026, UPESSC will review all objections submitted with valid proof. This section explains the process that follows before the result is declared.

  • Subject experts will examine each objection against the supporting evidence submitted.
  • Answers found to be genuinely incorrect will be revised in the final answer key.
  • UPESSC will release the UPTET Final Answer Key 2026 after this review.
  • The UPTET Result 2026 will be prepared and announced based on the final answer key.

OSSSC CRE Prelims Marking Scheme 2026

Before calculating a probable score from the answer key, it helps to know exactly how marks are awarded and deducted in the OSSSC CRE Prelims exam.

  • Each correct answer carries 1 mark.
  • Each incorrect answer attracts a negative marking of 0.25 mark.
  • No marks are deducted for questions left unattempted.

Formula to calculate score:

Score = (Number of Correct Answers × 1) − (Number of Incorrect Answers × 0.25)

Steps to Calculate Your Probable Score

  1. Download the OSSSC RI ARI Answer Key 2026 PDF.
  2. Compare each of your marked responses with the official key.
  3. Count the total correct answers and multiply by 1.
  4. Count the total incorrect answers and multiply by 0.25.
  5. Subtract the negative marks from the total correct marks to get your probable score.

What is the UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026?

The final answer key is the official, verified set of correct answers for the UP Home Guard written examination, published by after carefully reviewing all candidate objections raised against the provisional key. Understanding the difference between a provisional and a final answer key is important for every aspirant.

After the provisional answer key was released on 7 May 2026, candidates were given a window from 7 May to 10 May 2026 (midnight) to submit evidence-based objections against any answers they believed were incorrect. The board's subject experts then evaluated all objections received. As per the official notification, objections related to two questions were found to be valid across all six examination shifts. The final answer key incorporates these corrections, and the UP Home Guard Result 2026 has been computed based on this verified final key. No further objections or challenges are entertained after the release of the final answer key.

Direct Link to Download UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026

Candidates can access the final answer key and result directly through the official portal. Use the login credentials you registered with to access your personal score card and final answer key.

  • Official Website: uppbpb.gov.in

How to Download UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026 - Step-by-Step

Downloading the final answer key is a straightforward process. Follow these steps carefully to access your answer key and score card from the official portal without any confusion.

  1. Visit the Official Portal: Go to uppbpb.gov.in or the official website at uppbpb.gov.in.
  2. Click the Answer Key / Result Link: On the homepage, look for the notification titled "UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026" or "Home Guard Written Exam Result 2026."
  3. Enter Login Credentials: Input your Roll Number or Registration Number along with your Date of Birth (DD/MM/YYYY) and your Question Booklet Number where required.
  4. Click Submit: Press the Submit button to proceed to your personal result and answer key page.
  5. View Your Answer Key and Score: Your set-wise final answer key (Set A, B, C, or D) along with your score card will be displayed on the screen.
  6. Download and Save: Download the PDF and take a printout for future reference, especially for the upcoming Physical Standard Test (PST) and Document Verification stages.

 

Once you log in and download your scorecard, make sure to verify the following details carefully. Any discrepancy should be reported to immediately through official channels.

  • Candidate's Full Name
  • Father's Name
  • Date of Birth
  • Roll Number / Registration Number
  • Marks Obtained in Written Examination
  • Qualifying Status (Qualified / Not Qualified)
  • Category
  • District Allotted

UP Home Guard Cut-Off Marks 2026 - Category-Wise

The cut-off marks for the UP Home Guard Written Exam 2026 have been released district-wise and category-wise along with the result on 28 June 2026. Here are some important benchmarks every candidate should be aware of.

  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: Every candidate must secure at least 25% marks (25 out of 100) in the written examination to remain in contention. Candidates scoring below 25% are automatically disqualified from the recruitment process, regardless of category.
  • Safe Score (General/OBC): According to experts, a score of 72 marks or above is considered a safe score for General and OBC category candidates.
  • PET Preparation Range: Candidates who have correctly answered approximately 70 to 75 questions are advised to immediately begin preparation for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET/PST).
  • No Negative Marking: There is no negative marking in the UP Home Guard written examination. Every correct answer carries equal marks.

Note: Exact district-wise and category-wise cut-off marks are available on the official website. Candidates are advised to check the official portal for their specific district's cut-off figures.

Validity of the Final Answer Key - What Changed from Provisional to Final

The transition from a provisional to a final answer key is a standard and transparent process that ensures fairness to all candidates. Here is what happened between the provisional and final answer key stages for the UP Home Guard 2026 recruitment.

  • The provisional answer key was released on 7 May 2026.
  • Candidates were allowed to submit evidence-based objections from 7 May to 10 May 2026 (midnight).
  • Subject experts reviewed all submitted objections thoroughly.
  • Objections about two questions were found to be valid across all six examination shifts and were corrected in the final answer key.
  • The corrected final answer key formed the basis for result computation and merit list preparation.
  • No further challenges or objections are accepted after the release of the final answer key.

What Happens Next After the UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026?

Clearing the written examination is the first major step in the Home Guard selection process. Candidates who have qualified in the written test and appear on the merit list must prepare for the subsequent stages of the recruitment process.

Next Stages in UP Home Guard Recruitment 2026

  1. Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification. All original certificates, identity proofs, educational documents, and category certificates must be produced at this stage. Any mismatch or missing documents can lead to disqualification.
  2. Physical Standard Test (PST): Candidates must meet the prescribed physical standards regarding height, weight, and chest measurements as per norms.
  3. Physical Efficiency Test (PET): This test evaluates candidates on running, and other physical fitness parameters. Only those who pass the PST proceed to PET.
  4. Final Merit List: The final selection and merit list for all 41,424 Home Guard (Swayamsevak) posts will be prepared based on performance across all stages. The written examination marks form the primary basis for the final merit list.

  • Fill in candidate details, application number, roll number, exam centre division, and the specific question number with series
  • State the objection clearly and attach hard-copy documentary proof supporting the claim
  • Prepare a demand draft of ₹200 per question in favour of the Accounts Officer, J&K Services Selection Board
  • Submit the completed form, evidence, and demand draft in person at the Jammu or Srinagar JKSSB office within the 3-working-day window
  • Use a separate form for each question being objected to

JKSSB has clearly stated that objections will not be entertained after the stipulated period expires or if submitted through any mode other than offline in person.

What Happens After Objections Are Submitted?

This section explains the review process JKSSB follows once objections are received, and how it affects the final answer key.

Once the objection window closes, JKSSB reviews all submitted representations. If an objection is found correct, the answer key is revised accordingly for all candidates not just the one who raised it. However, JKSSB has clarified that no individual candidate will be notified about whether their specific objection was accepted or rejected. The final answer key, incorporating any approved corrections, is released subsequently and forms the basis for result preparation.

How to Download SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section walks you through the exact login process to access your final answer key, scorecard, and response sheet from the official SSC portal.

The download process requires your individual login credentials rather than a single public link, since the answer key and scorecard are personalized to each candidate's response sheet. Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Look for the notification related to the Tier 2 scorecard and final answer key for CGL 2025-26.
  3. Click on the candidate login link provided in the notification.
  4. Enter your Registration ID and Password to log in.
  5. Your scorecard, final answer key, and response sheet will be displayed on the screen.
  6. Download and save the PDF files for future reference before the access window closes.

Since this is a login-gated system tied to individual candidate records, there is no generic public download link that works for all candidates; each person must sign in with their own registered credentials.

What Information Does the Scorecard Contain

The scorecard released alongside the final answer key gives a detailed, section-wise breakdown of your performance. It typically includes your section-wise raw marks, normalized marks (since the exam was conducted across multiple shifts), your total score, and your qualifying status. Reviewing this alongside the final answer key helps you understand exactly how your final score was derived.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Marking Scheme 2026

Knowing the exact marking scheme is essential to understanding how your scorecard was calculated using the final answer key. The Tier 2 exam followed different marking rules for Paper 1 and Paper 2.

Paper Correct Answer Wrong Answer
Paper 1 (Sections I, II & Computer Module I) +3 marks -1 mark
Paper 2 (Statistics) +2 marks -0.50 marks

Unattempted questions carry zero marks under both papers, so there is no penalty for skipping a question you were unsure about. Paper 2 was applicable only to candidates who applied for Junior Statistical Officer and Statistical Investigator Grade II posts.

Timeline: From Provisional Key to Final Answer Key

This section traces the complete sequence of events from the Tier 2 exam to the release of the final answer key, helping candidates understand how each stage led to the next.

  • The Tier 2 exam was conducted on 18th and 19th January 2026.
  • The provisional answer key was released on 30th January 2026, with an objection window open until 3rd February 2026 (8:00 PM).
  • SSC reviewed all valid objections submitted against the provisional key.
  • The Tier 2 final result and merit list were declared on 8th April 2026, with 15,118 candidates provisionally selected.
  • The sliding process for post allocation was conducted between 13th and 22nd April 2026 across regional offices.
  • The final answer key, individual scorecards, and response sheets were released on 17th June 2026, accessible until 16th July 2026.

Why Check Your SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key and Scorecard

Even though the final result has already been announced, reviewing your final answer key and scorecard remains useful for several reasons. It allows you to verify the accuracy of your marks against the officially finalized answers, understand your section-wise and overall performance through normalized scores, and maintain a personal record for future reference, since access to these documents is time-limited. Candidates who were not selected can also use this data to identify weaker sections and plan more effectively for future SSC exam attempts.

About CXC Upstream

CXC Upstream is a vertically integrated mining group and one of the region's leading gold producers, with a substantial operating footprint in Geita, one of Tanzania's most prolific gold-producing regions.

The Group owns and operates four mining sites, including a major mountain-based gold asset supported by more than 50 years of demonstrable gold reserves. Its operations span the entire mining value chain, from extraction and processing to logistics and operational support. In addition to its mining assets, CXC Upstream operates a dedicated precious metals processing facility, maintains a fleet of specialist mining equipment, and provides private aviation services to support efficient movement of personnel, equipment and resources.

CXC Upstream is committed to the highest standards of governance, environmental stewardship, operational excellence and transparency, with ESG oversight aligned to the principles promoted by the International Council on Mining and Metals (ICMM).

The Accounts Assistant will support the business by ensuring accurate processing of financial transactions, maintaining accounting records, assisting with reconciliations, and financial reporting. The role requires strong attention to detail and the ability to work in a fast-paced operational environment while ensuring compliance with company policies and applicable financial regulations.

  • Process supplier invoices, expense claims and payment requests accurately and on time.
  • Prepare payment vouchers and maintain complete supporting documentation.
  • Perform daily posting ofstransactions into the accounting system.
  • Reconcile bank accounts, supplier statements and customer accounts.
  • Maintain accurate accounts payable and accounts receivable records.
  • Assist in preparing monthly financial reports and management accounts.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
  • Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up on receivables where required.
  • Maintain organised filing systems for financial records, contracts and supporting documents.
  • Assist with inventory and fixed asset record maintenance.

  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
  • Minimum of 2 years' experience in an accounting or finance role.

  • Knowledge of local tax regulations and financial reporting requirements.
  • Experience using accounting software or ERP systems.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.


Knowledge and Skills

  • Excellent numerical and analytical skills.
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

The Attraction Instructor is a versatile professional and pivotal position in ensuring guest satisfaction through the delivery of top-tier hospitality and safety standards within tours, attractions, and excursions on the Destination. This multifaceted role encompasses group instruction, safety enforcement, and specialized land, water, and height rescues. The Attraction Instructor role thrives on guest interaction, fostering a positive work atmosphere, prioritizing customer service, and delivering safety across all activities.

The Attraction Instructor specializes in leading, instructing, guiding, and overseeing tour participants, ensuring safety, enhancing the guest experience, and executing flawless operations in attraction, tours, activities, and experiences as directed by the Attractions & Recreation Lead. The core focus remains on guest safety, immediate response to emergencies, and proficient execution of advanced life-saving procedures in various environments.

Emotional resilience is paramount as the Attraction Instructor must maintain composure and rationality during high-stress situations, effectively managing their reactions and making sound decisions even in challenging circumstances. The role may also entail support for other aquatic activities and participation in the lifeguard program. Essential qualifications include exceptional guest engagement, meticulous attention to detail, a proactive problem-solving approach, unwavering concentration, strong swimming prowess, proficiency in CPR/First Aid, and comprehensive knowledge of our products and services.

All duties and responsibilities are performed following Companyâs Brand Standards, philosophy, policies, and SOPs, Public Health, Safety, Security, and Environmental Guidelines. All tours, attractions, and Instructors undergo rigorous third-party reviews to ensure the highest quality and safety standards. This Job Description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties performed by the Destination Team Member occupying this position. All Team Members may be required to perform any other job-related duties assigned by their Supervisor or Management. The nature of this job requires daily interactions with internal and external stakeholders.

About the role
 The Associate Data Analyst role exists to translate complex datasets into clear, defensible logic for our firm and its clients. You will provide the quantitative foundation for our advice, specifically supporting an ongoing mandate with a Manchester-based infrastructure organization to help them structure their operational reporting. This position is necessary to ensure our principals can form a view based on rigorous facts rather than intuition alone.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was established on the premise that critical business problems do not require large consulting teams or bloated methodology decks. We work with a limited number of holding companies, family groups, and government entities to provide honest, independent advice on governance and operating model efficiency. Our firm is principal-led, meaning the people who analyze the data are the same people who present the findings to the board. We operate as a fully remote firm, focusing our resources on the quality of our analysis and the strength of our client relationships rather than traditional office overhead or aggressive expansion targets.

What you will do
  • Support active mandates by collecting and organizing messy data from various client sources.
  • Help form a view on the performance of specific assets within a client portfolio.
  • Conduct research on market trends within the infrastructure and utility sectors to provide context for our analysis.
  • Clean and structure internal datasets to improve the speed of our decision making.
  • Draft clear, concise summaries of data findings that avoid jargon and focus on clarity.
  • Monitor key performance indicators for holding companies to identify long-term trends.
  • Assist in the review of corporate governance frameworks by auditing data flows and reporting structures.
  • Collaborate with our principals to refine our analytical approach for specific client problems.


What we are looking for
  • A high degree of curiosity regarding how large organizations and infrastructure projects function.
  • The ability to explain a complex dataset in simple, plain English without relying on buzzwords.
  • Logical rigor and the intellectual honesty to admit when the data does not support a current hypothesis.
  • Basic familiarity with spreadsheets and a structured approach to problem solving.
  • A preference for clarity over complexity in all written and numerical work.
  • The self-discipline to manage tasks and meet deadlines in a fully remote setting.


How we work
 Our firm operates entirely remotely, which allows us to find the best talent regardless of where they are located. We value output and precision over traditional corporate rituals. As this is an entry level role, you will work closely with our principals, receiving direct feedback on your work and your reasoning. We do not use layers of management. Instead, we encourage a culture where the merit of an argument is more important than the seniority of the person making it. Communication is frequent but focused, generally conducted through written notes and brief video calls to ensure we remain aligned on our active mandates.

What the role offers
  • Direct involvement in high-level strategy and governance mandates for significant regional entities.
  • Professional development through close mentorship from experienced firm principals.
  • The autonomy of a fully remote role with a focus on results rather than hours spent at a desk.
  • A working environment that prioritizes evidence-based analysis and clear communication.
  • Attractive and competitive pay for an entry level position in the data analysis field.

Noventra Group is hiring a remote Paid Media Specialist to support Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns across selected partner-brand initiatives.

This role is focused on performance marketing, campaign optimization, reporting, and paid media execution for brands and commercial partners working within Noventra Groupâs partner-brand ecosystem.

About Noventra Group

Noventra Group is a European-based brand partnership and commercial growth group working with selected brands, ecommerce businesses, retail partners, consumer product companies, and commercial partners across multiple markets.

The companyâs work is centered on partner-brand development, market expansion, campaign coordination, digital acquisition, and performance-focused commercial operations.

Noventra Group is not positioned as a traditional marketing agency. The team works across partner-brand campaigns where paid media, commercial strategy, campaign performance, and clear reporting are important parts of the operating structure.

Role Overview

The Paid Media Specialist will work across Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns for partner brands in ecommerce, retail, lifestyle, consumer products, premium goods, and service-based markets.

The role requires strong hands-on paid media experience, clear analytical thinking, practical optimization judgment, and the ability to communicate campaign performance in a structured and professional way.

The ideal candidate understands how to review paid advertising data, identify performance issues, improve campaign structure, test creative angles, monitor budget efficiency, and produce clear recommendations that support better business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

- Plan, launch, monitor, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads
- Review campaign structure, audience targeting, budget allocation, bidding strategy, and conversion paths
- Monitor key performance indicators including CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, lead quality, and budget efficiency
- Identify issues in campaign setup, tracking, creative performance, funnel quality, and landing page conversion flow
- Review ad creatives, hooks, messaging, visuals, offers, and campaign angles
- Prepare clear campaign reports, optimization notes, and performance summaries
- Recommend practical next steps based on campaign data and commercial objectives
- Support campaign testing, scaling decisions, and performance improvement plans
- Work with remote teams across different markets and maintain clear written communication
- Keep campaign documentation organized, including changes, observations, results, and recommendations

Required Experience

- Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns
- Hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns
- Experience with Search, Display, Shopping, YouTube, Performance Max, or similar Google Ads campaign types
- Strong understanding of paid media optimization, campaign reporting, and performance analysis
- Ability to interpret advertising data and make practical campaign decisions
- Experience managing advertising budgets with measurable performance outcomes
- Good written English communication skills
- Ability to work remotely, manage priorities independently, and communicate clearly
- Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple campaigns or brand accounts

Preferred Experience

- Experience with ecommerce, DTC, retail, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, wellness, premium products, or service-based campaigns
- Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Shopify, landing pages, CRM tracking, or conversion tracking setup
- Experience preparing weekly or monthly paid media reports
- Experience with creative testing, ad angle analysis, funnel review, and campaign scaling
- Experience working with international teams or multiple partner-brand campaigns
- Experience with business-managed advertising accounts, invoiced ad accounts, monthly billing structures, or partner-brand ad operations is a plus

Working Style

This is a remote role suited for someone who can work independently, communicate professionally, and provide structured campaign insights without requiring constant supervision.

Noventra Group values clear reporting, reliable communication, organized work, data responsibility, and practical problem-solving. The role requires a professional approach to campaign management, partner-brand communication, and performance improvement.

Compensation and Engagement

Compensation is based on experience, capability, availability, and engagement structure.

The role may be suitable for a long-term remote collaboration depending on experience, performance, communication quality, and alignment with Noventra Groupâs partner-brand operating standards.
